IndoorR2X: Indoor Robot-to-Everything Coordination with LLM-Driven Planning

简要说明：该论文介绍了IndoorR2X，一个新的基准和仿真框架，用于LLM驱动的多机器人任务规划，利用机器人到一切(R2X)的感知和通信，整合来自机器人和静态物联网设备的观察，以提高场景理解和协调能力。

TLDR: The paper introduces IndoorR2X, a new benchmark and simulation framework for LLM-driven multi-robot task planning that leverages Robot-to-Everything (R2X) perception and communication, integrating observations from robots and static IoT devices to improve scene understanding and coordination.

Abstract: Although robot-to-robot (R2R) communication improves indoor scene understanding beyond what a single robot can achieve, R2R alone cannot overcome partial observability without substantial exploration overhead or scaling team size. In contrast, many indoor environments already include low-cost Internet of Things (IoT) sensors (e.g., cameras) that provide persistent, building-wide context beyond onboard perception. We therefore introduce IndoorR2X, the first benchmark and simulation framework for Large Language Model (LLM)-driven multi-robot task planning with Robot-to-Everything (R2X) perception and communication in indoor environments. IndoorR2X integrates observations from mobile robots and static IoT devices to construct a global semantic state that supports scalable scene understanding, reduces redundant exploration, and enables high-level coordination through LLM-based planning. IndoorR2X provides configurable simulation environments, sensor layouts, robot teams, and task suites to systematically evaluate high-level semantic coordination strategies. Extensive experiments across diverse settings demonstrate that IoT-augmented world modeling improves multi-robot efficiency and reliability, and we highlight key insights and failure modes for advancing LLM-based collaboration between robot teams and indoor IoT sensors.

摘要（中文）：尽管机器人对机器人（R2R）通信能够提升室内场景理解能力，超越单个机器人所能达到的水平，但仅靠R2R本身无法克服局部可观测性问题，除非付出巨大的探索代价或扩大团队规模。相比之下，许多室内环境中已经部署了低成本的物联网（IoT）传感器（例如，摄像头），这些传感器能够提供持久的、覆盖整个建筑范围的上下文信息，超出机器人自身感知范围。因此，我们推出了IndoorR2X，这是第一个用于大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的、基于机器人对万物（R2X）感知和通信的多机器人任务规划的基准和仿真框架。IndoorR2X集成了来自移动机器人和静态物联网设备的观测数据，构建了一个全局语义状态，支持可扩展的场景理解，减少冗余探索，并通过基于LLM的规划实现高层次的协同。IndoorR2X提供了可配置的仿真环境、传感器布局、机器人团队和任务套件，用于系统地评估高层次的语义协同策略。在不同环境下的广泛实验表明，物联网增强的世界建模提高了多机器人的效率和可靠性，并且我们重点介绍了关键的见解和失效模式，以推进机器人团队和室内物联网传感器之间基于LLM的协作。

Authors: Fan Yang, Soumya Teotia, Shaunak A. Mehta, Prajit KrisshnaKumar, Quanting Xie, Jun Liu, Yueqi Song, Li Wenkai, Atsunori Moteki, Kanji Uchino, Yonatan Bisk

X-World: Controllable Ego-Centric Multi-Camera World Models for Scalable End-to-End Driving

简要说明：该论文介绍了X-World，一个可控的多摄像头生成世界模型，用于自动驾驶仿真。它通过基于动作和可选场景控制生成逼真且可控的未来多视角视频流，从而实现可扩展和可重现的评估。

TLDR: The paper introduces X-World, a controllable multi-camera generative world model for autonomous driving simulation, enabling scalable and reproducible evaluation by generating realistic and controllable future multi-view video streams based on actions and optional scene controls.

Abstract: Scalable and reliable evaluation is increasingly critical in the end-to-end era of autonomous driving, where vision--language--action (VLA) policies directly map raw sensor streams to driving actions. Yet, current evaluation pipelines still rely heavily on real-world road testing, which is costly, biased toward limited scenario coverage, and difficult to reproduce. These challenges motivate a real-world simulator that can generate realistic future observations under proposed actions, while remaining controllable and stable over long horizons. We present X-World, an action-conditioned multi-camera generative world model that simulates future observations directly in video space. Given synchronized multi-view camera history and a future action sequence, X-World generates future multi-camera video streams that follow the commanded actions. To ensure reproducible and editable scene rollouts, X-World further supports optional controls over dynamic traffic agents and static road elements, and retains a text-prompt interface for appearance-level control (e.g., weather and time of day). Beyond world simulation, X-World also enables video style transfer by conditioning on appearance prompts while preserving the underlying action and scene dynamics. At the core of X-World is a multi-view latent video generator designed to explicitly encourage cross-view geometric consistency and temporal coherence under diverse control signals. Experiments show that X-World achieves high-quality multi-view video generation with (i) strong view consistency across cameras, (ii) stable temporal dynamics over long rollouts, and (iii) high controllability with strict action following and faithful adherence to optional scene controls. These properties make X-World a practical foundation for scalable and reproducible evaluation.

摘要（中文）：在自动驾驶端到端时代，可扩展且可靠的评估变得越来越重要，其中视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 策略直接将原始传感器流映射到驾驶动作。然而，当前的评估流程仍然严重依赖于现实世界的道路测试，这成本高昂、存在对有限场景覆盖的偏见且难以重现。这些挑战促使我们需要一个现实世界的模拟器，该模拟器能够在提出的动作下生成逼真的未来观测，同时在长时程内保持可控性和稳定性。我们提出了 X-World，一个动作条件的多相机生成世界模型，可以直接在视频空间中模拟未来的观测。给定同步的多视点相机历史和未来的动作序列，X-World 可以生成遵循指令动作的未来多相机视频流。为了确保可重现和可编辑的场景展开，X-World 还支持对动态交通智能体和静态道路元素的额外控制，并保留了用于外观级别控制（例如，天气和一天中的时间）的文本提示接口。除了世界模拟，X-World 还通过在保留底层动作和场景动态的同时，对外观提示进行条件化处理，来实现视频风格迁移。X-World 的核心是一个多视点潜在视频生成器，旨在明确地促进在多样控制信号下的跨视点几何一致性和时间连贯性。实验表明，X-World 可以实现高质量的多视点视频生成，具有 (i) 跨相机的强大视点一致性，(ii) 长时程展开中的稳定时间动态，以及 (iii) 严格遵循动作和忠实遵守可选场景控制的高度可控性。这些特性使 X-World 成为可扩展且可重现评估的实用基础。

Authors: Chaoda Zheng, Sean Li, Jinhao Deng, Zhennan Wang, Shijia Chen, Liqiang Xiao, Ziheng Chi, Hongbin Lin, Kangjie Chen, Boyang Wang, Yu Zhang, Xianming Liu

HUGE-Bench: A Benchmark for High-Level UAV Vision-Language-Action Tasks

简要说明：该论文介绍了HUGE-Bench，一个新的评估UAV视觉-语言-动作模型在高级指令下的性能的基准，这些指令需要在逼真的环境中执行复杂、安全的轨迹。

TLDR: The paper introduces HUGE-Bench, a new benchmark for evaluating UAV vision-language-action models on high-level commands requiring complex, safe trajectories in realistic environments.

Abstract: Existing UAV vision-language navigation (VLN) benchmarks have enabled language-guided flight, but they largely focus on long, step-wise route descriptions with goal-centric evaluation, making them less diagnostic for real operations where brief, high-level commands must be grounded into safe multi-stage behaviors. We present HUGE-Bench, a benchmark for High-Level UAV Vision-Language-Action (HL-VLA) tasks that tests whether an agent can interpret concise language and execute complex, process-oriented trajectories with safety awareness. HUGE-Bench comprises 4 real-world digital twin scenes, 8 high-level tasks, and 2.56M meters of trajectories, and is built on an aligned 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-Mesh representation that combines photorealistic rendering with collision-capable geometry for scalable generation and collision-aware evaluation. We introduce process-oriented and collision-aware metrics to assess process fidelity, terminal accuracy, and safety. Experiments on representative state-of-the-art VLA models reveal significant gaps in high-level semantic completion and safe execution, highlighting HUGE-Bench as a diagnostic testbed for high-level UAV autonomy.

摘要（中文）：现有的无人机视觉-语言导航（VLN）基准测试促进了语言引导的飞行，但它们主要关注较长的、阶梯式的路线描述，并采用以目标为中心的评估方式，使其在实际操作中诊断性不足，因为实际操作需要将简短、高层次的命令转变为安全的多阶段行为。我们提出了HUGE-Bench，一个用于高层次无人机视觉-语言-动作（HL-VLA）任务的基准测试，旨在测试智能体是否能够理解简洁的语言并执行复杂的、面向过程的轨迹，同时具备安全意识。HUGE-Bench包含4个真实世界的数字孪生场景、8个高层次任务和256万米轨迹，并构建于一个对齐的3D高斯溅射（3DGS）-网格表示之上，该表示结合了照片级真实感渲染和具备碰撞能力的几何结构，以实现可扩展的生成和碰撞感知评估。我们引入了面向过程和碰撞感知的指标，以评估过程保真度、终端精度和安全性。对代表性的最先进VLA模型进行的实验表明，在高层次语义理解和安全执行方面存在显著差距，突显了HUGE-Bench作为高层次无人机自主性的诊断性测试平台的作用。

Authors: Jingyu Guo, Ziye Chen, Ziwen Li, Zhengqing Gao, Jiaxin Huang, Hanlue Zhang, Fengming Huang, Yu Yao, Tongliang Liu, Mingming Gong

Physion-Eval: Evaluating Physical Realism in Generated Video via Human Reasoning

简要说明：该论文介绍了Physion-Eval，一个大规模benchmark，通过专家人类推理评估生成视频的物理真实性，揭示了当前最先进的视频生成模型在物理关键场景方面的显著局限性。

TLDR: The paper introduces Physion-Eval, a large-scale benchmark for evaluating the physical realism of generated videos using expert human reasoning, revealing significant limitations in state-of-the-art video generation models regarding physics-critical scenarios.

Abstract: Video generation models are increasingly used as world simulators for storytelling, simulation, and embodied AI. As these models advance, a key question arises: do generated videos obey the physical laws of the real world? Existing evaluations largely rely on automated metrics or coarse human judgments such as preferences or rubric-based checks. While useful for assessing perceptual quality, these methods provide limited insight into when and why generated dynamics violate real-world physical constraints. We introduce Physion-Eval, a large-scale benchmark of expert human reasoning for diagnosing physical realism failures in videos generated by five state-of-the-art models across egocentric and exocentric views, containing 10,990 expert reasoning traces spanning 22 fine-grained physical categories. Each generated video is derived from a corresponding real-world reference video depicting a clear physical process, and annotated with temporally localized glitches, structured failure categories, and natural-language explanations of the violated physical behavior. Using this dataset, we reveal a striking limitation of current video generation models: in physics-critical scenarios, 83.3% of exocentric and 93.5% of egocentric generated videos exhibit at least one human-identifiable physical glitch. We hope Physion-Eval will set a new standard for physical realism evaluation and guide the development of physics-grounded video generation. The benchmark is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/PhysionLabs/Physion-Eval.

摘要（中文）：视频生成模型正日益成为叙事、模拟和具身人工智能的世界模拟器。随着这些模型的进步，一个关键问题随之出现：生成的视频是否遵循真实世界的物理定律？现有的评估主要依赖于自动化指标或粗略的人工判断，例如偏好或基于规则的检查。这些方法虽然对评估感知质量很有用，但对于生成的动态何时以及为何违反真实世界的物理约束，提供的洞察力有限。我们推出了 Physion-Eval，这是一个大规模的专家人工推理基准，用于诊断五个最先进模型生成的视频中物理真实性失效的情况，视频涵盖第一人称和第三人称视角，包含 10,990 条专家推理轨迹，横跨 22 个细粒度的物理类别。每个生成的视频都源自一个对应的真实世界参考视频，该视频描述了一个清晰的物理过程，并标注了时序上定位的故障、结构化的失效类别以及对违反的物理行为的自然语言解释。使用这个数据集，我们揭示了当前视频生成模型的一个显著局限性：在物理关键场景中，83.3% 的第三人称和 93.5% 的第一人称生成视频表现出至少一个人类可识别的物理故障。我们希望 Physion-Eval 能够为物理真实性评估设定一个新的标准，并指导基于物理的视频生成的发展。该基准在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/PhysionLabs/Physion-Eval 上公开提供。

Authors: Qin Zhang, Peiyu Jing, Hong-Xing Yu, Fangqiang Ding, Fan Nie, Weimin Wang, Yilun Du, James Zou, Jiajun Wu, Bing Shuai

The Robot's Inner Critic: Self-Refinement of Social Behaviors through VLM-based Replanning

简要说明：该论文介绍了一个名为CRISP的框架，该框架使机器人能够使用视觉语言模型（VLM）自我批判和改进其社交行为，与之前的各种机器人平台上的方法相比，实现了更高的偏好度和适当性评分。

TLDR: The paper introduces CRISP, a framework enabling robots to self-critique and refine their social behaviors using VLMs, achieving higher preference and appropriateness ratings compared to previous methods across various robot platforms.

Abstract: Conventional robot social behavior generation has been limited in flexibility and autonomy, relying on predefined motions or human feedback. This study proposes CRISP (Critique-and-Replan for Interactive Social Presence), an autonomous framework where a robot critiques and replans its own actions by leveraging a Vision-Language Model (VLM) as a `human-like social critic.' CRISP integrates (1) extraction of movable joints and constraints by analyzing the robot's description file (e.g., MJCF), (2) generation of step-by-step behavior plans based on situational context, (3) generation of low-level joint control code by referencing visual information (joint range-of-motion visualizations), (4) VLM-based evaluation of social appropriateness and naturalness, including pinpointing erroneous steps, and (5) iterative refinement of behaviors through reward-based search. This approach is not tied to a specific robot API; it can generate subtly different, human-like motions on various platforms using only the robot's structure file. In a user study involving five different robot types and 20 scenarios, including mobile manipulators and humanoids, our proposed method achieved significantly higher preference and situational appropriateness ratings compared to previous methods. This research presents a general framework that minimizes human intervention while expanding the robot's autonomous interaction capabilities and cross-platform applicability. Detailed result videos and supplementary information regarding this work are available at: https://limjiyu99.github.io/inner-critic/

摘要（中文）：传统的机器人社交行为生成在灵活性和自主性方面受到限制，依赖于预定义的动作或人工反馈。本研究提出了CRISP（用于交互式社交临场感的评论与重规划），一个自主框架，其中机器人利用视觉-语言模型（VLM）作为“类人社交评论家”来评论和重规划自身的动作。CRISP集成了（1）通过分析机器人描述文件（例如，MJCF）提取可移动关节和约束条件，（2）基于情境生成逐步行为计划，（3）通过参考视觉信息（关节运动范围可视化）生成底层关节控制代码，（4）基于VLM的社交适当性和自然度评估，包括精确定位错误的步骤，以及（5）通过基于奖励的搜索迭代改进行为。这种方法不依赖于特定的机器人API；它仅使用机器人的结构文件就可以在各种平台上生成细微不同、类人的动作。在一项涉及五种不同机器人类型和20种场景（包括移动机械臂和人形机器人）的用户研究中，与以往的方法相比，我们提出的方法在偏好度和情境适当性评级方面显著更高。这项研究提出了一个通用框架，该框架最大限度地减少了人工干预，同时扩展了机器人的自主交互能力和跨平台适用性。 有关这项工作的详细结果视频和补充信息，请访问：https://limjiyu99.github.io/inner-critic/

Authors: Jiyu Lim, Youngwoo Yoon, Kwanghyun Park

AGILE: A Comprehensive Workflow for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation Learning

简要说明：本文提出了AGILE，一个用于人形机器人强化学习的端到端工作流程，重点在于标准化策略开发生命周期，并改善在真实机器人上的模拟到真实的迁移。

TLDR: This paper presents AGILE, an end-to-end workflow for humanoid reinforcement learning, focusing on standardizing the policy-development lifecycle and improving sim-to-real transfer on real robots.

Abstract: Recent advances in reinforcement learning (RL) have enabled impressive humanoid behaviors in simulation, yet transferring these results to new robots remains challenging. In many real deployments, the primary bottleneck is no longer simulation throughput or algorithm design, but the absence of systematic infrastructure that links environment verification, training, evaluation, and deployment in a coherent loop. To address this gap, we present AGILE, an end-to-end workflow for humanoid RL that standardizes the policy-development lifecycle to mitigate common sim-to-real failure modes. AGILE comprises four stages: (1) interactive environment verification, (2) reproducible training, (3) unified evaluation, and (4) descriptor-driven deployment via robot/task configuration descriptors. For evaluation stage, AGILE supports both scenario-based tests and randomized rollouts under a shared suite of motion-quality diagnostics, enabling automated regression testing and principled robustness assessment. AGILE also incorporates a set of training stabilizations and algorithmic enhancements in training stage to improve optimization stability and sim-to-real transfer. With this pipeline in place, we validate AGILE across five representative humanoid skills spanning locomotion, recovery, motion imitation, and loco-manipulation on two hardware platforms (Unitree G1 and Booster T1), achieving consistent sim-to-real transfer. Overall, AGILE shows that a standardized, end-to-end workflow can substantially improve the reliability and reproducibility of humanoid RL development.

摘要（中文）：近年来，强化学习（RL）的进展已能在模拟环境中实现令人印象深刻的类人机器人行为，但将这些成果迁移到新机器人上仍然充满挑战。在许多实际部署中，主要的瓶颈不再是模拟吞吐量或算法设计，而是缺乏将环境验证、训练、评估和部署在一个连贯循环中进行连接的系统性基础设施。 为解决这一差距，我们提出了AGILE，一个用于类人机器人RL的端到端工作流，它通过标准化策略开发生命周期来减轻常见的模拟到真实（sim-to-real）失败模式。AGILE包括四个阶段：（1）交互式环境验证，（2）可复现的训练，（3）统一的评估，以及（4）通过机器人/任务配置描述符进行基于描述符驱动的部署。在评估阶段，AGILE支持基于场景的测试和在共享的运动质量诊断套件下的随机rollout，从而实现自动化回归测试和原则性的鲁棒性评估。AGILE还在训练阶段纳入了一组训练稳定和算法增强方法，以提高优化稳定性和模拟到真实迁移效果。 通过上述流水线，我们验证了AGILE在五个具有代表性的类人机器人技能上的有效性，这些技能涵盖了在两个硬件平台（宇树G1和Booster T1）上的运动、恢复、动作模仿和运动-操作，实现了稳定一致的模拟到真实迁移。总而言之，AGILE表明，一个标准化的端到端工作流可以显著提高类人机器人RL开发的可靠性和可复现性。

Authors: Huihua Zhao, Rafael Cathomen, Lionel Gulich, Wei Liu, Efe Arda Ongan, Michael Lin, Shalin Jain, Soha Pouya, Yan Chang

Not an Obstacle for Dog, but a Hazard for Human: A Co-Ego Navigation System for Guide Dog Robots

简要说明：该论文介绍了一种新型导盲犬机器人导航系统，通过融合机器人为中心的地面感知与用户的高架自我中心视角来解决“视点不对称问题”，从而提高安全性并降低认知负荷。

TLDR: This paper introduces a novel navigation system for guide dog robots that addresses the 'viewpoint asymmetry problem' by fusing robot-centric ground sensing with a user's elevated egocentric perspective to improve safety and reduce cognitive load.

Abstract: Guide dogs offer independence to Blind and Low-Vision (BLV) individuals, yet their limited availability leaves the vast majority of BLV users without access. Quadruped robotic guide dogs present a promising alternative, but existing systems rely solely on the robot's ground-level sensors for navigation, overlooking a critical class of hazards: obstacles that are transparent to the robot yet dangerous at human body height, such as bent branches. We term this the viewpoint asymmetry problem and present the first system to explicitly address it. Our Co-Ego system adopts a dual-branch obstacle avoidance framework that integrates the robot-centric ground sensing with the user's elevated egocentric perspective to ensure comprehensive navigation safety. Deployed on a quadruped robot, the system is evaluated in a controlled user study with sighted participants under blindfold across three conditions: unassisted, single-view, and cross-view fusion. Results demonstrate that cross-view fusion significantly reduces collision times and cognitive load, verifying the necessity of viewpoint complementarity for safe robotic guide dog navigation.

摘要（中文）：导盲犬为盲人和低视力人士（BLV）提供了独立性，但其有限的供应量导致绝大多数BLV用户无法获得服务。四足机器人导盲犬提供了一个有前景的替代方案，但现有系统仅依赖于机器人的地面传感器进行导航，忽略了一类关键危险：对机器人透明但在人体高度却危险的障碍物，例如弯曲的树枝。我们称之为视点不对称问题，并提出了第一个明确解决该问题的系统。我们的Co-Ego系统采用双分支避障框架，该框架集成了以机器人为中心的地面传感和用户的高处自我中心视角，以确保全面的导航安全性。该系统部署在一只四足机器人上，并在有对照的受试者研究中，由蒙着眼睛的视力正常参与者在三种情况下进行评估：无辅助、单视角和跨视角融合。结果表明，跨视角融合显著减少了碰撞时间和认知负荷，验证了视点互补性对于安全机器人导盲犬导航的必要性。

Authors: Ruiping Liu, Jingqi Zhang, Junwei Zheng, Yufan Chen, Peter Seungjune Lee, Di Wen, Kunyu Peng, Jiaming Zhang, Kailun Yang, Katja Mombaur, Rainer Stiefelhagen

GustPilot: A Hierarchical DRL-INDI Framework for Wind-Resilient Quadrotor Navigation

简要说明：GustPilot 提出了一个用于抗风四旋翼导航的分层 DRL 和增量非线性动态逆 (INDI) 框架，在具有挑战性的风力条件下，与 DRL-PID 基线相比，实现了卓越的性能。

TLDR: GustPilot presents a hierarchical DRL and Incremental Nonlinear Dynamic Inversion (INDI) framework for wind-resilient quadrotor navigation, achieving superior performance compared to a DRL-PID baseline in challenging wind conditions.

Abstract: Wind disturbances remain a key barrier to reliable autonomous navigation for lightweight quadrotors, where the rapidly varying airflow can destabilize both planning and tracking. This paper introduces GustPilot, a hierarchical wind-resilient navigation stack in which a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) policy generates inertial-frame velocity reference for gate traversal. At the same time, a geometric Incremental Nonlinear Dynamic Inversion (INDI) controller provides low-level tracking with fast residual disturbance rejection. The INDI layer achieves this by providing incremental feedback on both specific linear acceleration and angular acceleration rate, using onboard sensor measurements to reject wind disturbances rapidly. Robustness is obtained through a two-level strategy, wind-aware planning learned via fan-jet domain randomization during training, and rapid execution-time disturbance rejection by the INDI tracking controller. We evaluate GustPilot in real flights on a 50g quad-copter platform against a DRL-PID baseline across four scenarios ranging from no-wind to fully dynamic conditions with a moving gate and a moving disturbance source. Despite being trained only in a minimal single-gate and single-fan setup, the policy generalizes to significantly more complex environments (up to six gates and four fans) without retraining. Across 80 experiments, DRL-INDI achieves a 94.7% versus 55.0% for DRL-PID as average Overall Success Rate (OSR), reduces tracking RMSE up to 50%, and sustains speeds up to 1.34 m/s under wind disturbances up to 3.5 m/s. These results demonstrate that combining DRL-based velocity planning with structured INDI disturbance rejection provides a practical and generalizable approach to wind-resilient autonomous flight navigation.

摘要（中文）：风扰对轻型四旋翼飞行器可靠的自主导航仍然构成关键障碍，因为快速变化的气流会使规划和跟踪都不稳定。本文介绍了一种抗风的分层导航堆栈 GustPilot，其中深度强化学习 (DRL) 策略生成惯性系速度参考，用于穿越飞行门。同时，几何增量非线性动态逆 (INDI) 控制器提供低层级的快速残余扰动抑制跟踪。INDI 层通过提供对特定线性加速度和角加速度率的增量反馈，并使用机载传感器测量值来快速抑制风扰，从而实现这一点。通过两级策略获得鲁棒性：通过训练期间的风扇射流域随机化学习到的风感知规划，以及 INDI 跟踪控制器在执行时快速扰动抑制。我们在重达 50 克的四旋翼飞行器平台上，针对 DRL-PID 基线，在从无风到完全动态的包含移动飞行门和移动扰动源的四种场景中，通过实际飞行评估了 GustPilot。尽管仅在最小的单飞行门和单风扇设置中进行训练，该策略仍能推广到更加复杂的环境（最多 6 个飞行门和 4 个风扇），而无需重新训练。在 80 项实验中，DRL-INDI 的平均总成功率 (OSR) 达到 94.7%，而 DRL-PID 为 55.0%，跟踪 RMSE 降低高达 50%，并在高达 3.5 m/s 的风扰下保持高达 1.34 m/s 的速度。这些结果表明，将基于 DRL 的速度规划与结构化的 INDI 扰动抑制相结合，为抗风自主飞行导航提供了一种实用且可推广的方法。

Authors: Amir Atef Habel, Roohan Ahmed Khan, Fawad Mehboob, Clement Fortin, Dzmitry Tsetserukou

Generalized Task-Driven Design of Soft Robots via Reduced-Order FEM-based Surrogate Modeling

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于降阶有限元方法的代理建模流程，用于高效且可泛化的任务驱动型软体机器人设计，该流程通过模拟到真实的迁移以及使用强化学习和进化优化的两个设计研究进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a reduced-order FEM-based surrogate modeling pipeline for efficient and generalizable task-driven soft robot design, validated through sim-to-real transfer and two design studies using RL and evolutionary optimization.

Abstract: Task-driven design of soft robots requires models that are physically accurate and computationally efficient, while remaining transferable across actuator designs and task scenarios. However, existing modeling approaches typically face a fundamental trade-off between physical fidelity and computational efficiency, which limits model reuse across design and task variations and constrains scalable task-driven optimization. This paper presents a unified reduced-order finite element method (FEM)-based surrogate modeling pipeline for generalized task-driven soft robot design. High-fidelity FEM simulations characterize actuator behavior at the modular level, from which compact surrogate joint models are constructed for evaluation within a pseudo-rigid body model (PRBM). A meta-model maps actuator design parameters to surrogate representations, enabling rapid instantiation across a parameterized actuator family. The resulting models are embedded into a PRBM-based simulation environment, supporting task-level simulation and optimization under realistic physical constraints. The proposed pipeline is validated through sim-to-real transfer across multiple actuator types, including bellow-type pneumatic actuators and a tendon-driven soft finger, as well as two task-driven design studies: soft gripper co-design via Reinforcement Learning (RL) and 3D actuator shape matching via evolutionary optimization. The results demonstrate high accuracy, efficiency, and reliable reuse, providing a scalable foundation for autonomous task-driven soft robot design.

摘要（中文）：面向任务的软体机器人设计需要物理精确且计算高效的模型，同时还要能够在不同的执行器设计和任务场景中迁移。然而，现有的建模方法通常面临物理保真度和计算效率之间的根本权衡，这限制了模型在设计和任务变化中的重用，并制约了可扩展的面向任务的优化。本文提出了一种统一的基于降阶有限元方法（FEM）的代理建模流程，用于通用的面向任务的软体机器人设计。高保真度的FEM模拟在模块化级别上表征执行器的行为，从中构建紧凑的代理关节模型，以便在伪刚体模型（PRBM）中进行评估。一个元模型将执行器设计参数映射到代理表示，从而能够在参数化的执行器系列中进行快速实例化。由此产生的模型嵌入到基于PRBM 的仿真环境中，支持在实际物理约束下进行任务级仿真和优化。所提出的流程通过跨多种执行器类型（包括波纹管式气动执行器和腱驱动的软手指）的sim-to-real迁移以及两项面向任务的设计研究（通过强化学习（RL）进行的软抓手协同设计以及通过进化优化进行的3D执行器形状匹配）进行了验证。结果表明了高精度、高效率和可靠的重用性，为自主的面向任务的软体机器人设计提供了可扩展的基础。

Authors: Yao Yao, David Howard, Perla Maiolino

Morphology-Consistent Humanoid Interaction through Robot-Centric Video Synthesis

简要说明：本文介绍了一个名为Dream2Act的框架，该框架通过使用以机器人为中心的视频合成来实现零样本类人机器人交互，避免了以人为中心的姿态估计和形态重定向错误，从而提高了任务成功率。

TLDR: The paper introduces Dream2Act, a framework that uses robot-centric video synthesis to enable zero-shot humanoid robot interaction by avoiding human-centric pose estimation and morphology retargeting errors, thereby improving task success rates.

Abstract: Equipping humanoid robots with versatile interaction skills typically requires either extensive policy training or explicit human-to-robot motion retargeting. However, learning-based policies face prohibitive data collection costs. Meanwhile, retargeting relies on human-centric pose estimation (e.g., SMPL), introducing a morphology gap. Skeletal scale mismatches result in severe spatial misalignments when mapped to robots, compromising interaction success. In this work, we propose Dream2Act, a robot-centric framework enabling zero-shot interaction through generative video synthesis. Given a third-person image of the robot and target object, our framework leverages video generation models to envision the robot completing the task with morphology-consistent motion. We employ a high-fidelity pose extraction system to recover physically feasible, robot-native joint trajectories from these synthesized dreams, subsequently executed via a general-purpose whole-body controller. Operating strictly within the robot-native coordinate space, Dream2Act avoids retargeting errors and eliminates task-specific policy training. We evaluate Dream2Act on the Unitree G1 across four whole-body mobile interaction tasks: ball kicking, sofa sitting, bag punching, and box hugging. Dream2Act achieves a 37.5% overall success rate, compared to 0% for conventional retargeting. While retargeting fails to establish correct physical contacts due to the morphology gap (with errors compounded during locomotion), Dream2Act maintains robot-consistent spatial alignment, enabling reliable contact formation and substantially higher task completion.

摘要（中文）：赋予人形机器人多功能的交互能力通常需要大量的策略训练或显式的人到机器人运动重定向。然而，基于学习的策略面临着高昂的数据收集成本。同时，重定向依赖于以人为中心的姿态估计（例如，SMPL），引入了形态差异。骨骼尺度的不匹配会导致映射到机器人时出现严重的空间错位，从而影响交互的成功。在这项工作中，我们提出了 Dream2Act，一个机器人中心的框架，通过生成式视频合成实现零样本交互。给定机器人和目标物体的第三人称图像，我们的框架利用视频生成模型来设想机器人完成任务的、与形态结构一致的运动。我们采用高保真姿态提取系统，从这些合成的“梦想”中恢复物理上可行的、机器人原生的关节轨迹，随后通过通用全身控制器执行这些轨迹。Dream2Act 严格在机器人原生坐标空间内运行，避免了重定向错误并消除了特定于任务的策略训练。我们使用 Unitree G1 在四个全身移动交互任务上评估了 Dream2Act：踢球、沙发坐、击打沙袋和拥抱盒子。Dream2Act 实现了 37.5% 的总体成功率，而传统重定向的成功率为 0%。虽然重定向由于形态差异而无法建立正确的物理接触（误差在运动过程中会加剧），但 Dream2Act 保持了与机器人一致的空间对齐，从而能够可靠地形成接触并实现显著更高的任务完成度。

Authors: Weisheng Xu, Jian Li, Yi Gu, Bin Yang, Haodong Chen, Shuyi Lin, Mingqian Zhou, Jing Tan, Qiwei Wu, Xiangrui Jiang, Taowen Wang, Jiawen Wen, Qiwei Liang, Jiaxi Zhang, Renjing Xu

DynFlowDrive: Flow-Based Dynamic World Modeling for Autonomous Driving

简要说明：该论文介绍了DynFlowDrive，一个基于流的自动驾驶潜在世界模型，它使用修正流公式预测不同驾驶行为下的场景状态转换，并且在不增加额外推理开销的情况下，在驾驶框架中表现出改进。

TLDR: The paper introduces DynFlowDrive, a flow-based latent world model for autonomous driving that predicts scene state transitions under different driving actions using a rectified flow formulation, showing improvements in driving frameworks without extra inference overhead.

Abstract: Recently, world models have been incorporated into the autonomous driving systems to improve the planning reliability. Existing approaches typically predict future states through appearance generation or deterministic regression, which limits their ability to capture trajectory-conditioned scene evolution and leads to unreliable action planning. To address this, we propose DynFlowDrive, a latent world model that leverages flow-based dynamics to model the transition of world states under different driving actions. By adopting the rectifiedflow formulation, the model learns a velocity field that describes how the scene state changes under different driving actions, enabling progressive prediction of future latent states. Building upon this, we further introduce a stability-aware multi-mode trajectory selection strategy that evaluates candidate trajectories according to the stability of the induced scene transitions. Extensive experiments on the nuScenes and NavSim benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements across diverse driving frameworks without introducing additional inference overhead. Source code will be abaliable at https://github.com/xiaolul2/DynFlowDrive.

摘要（中文）：最近，世界模型已被纳入自动驾驶系统以提高规划的可靠性。现有方法通常通过外观生成或确定性回归来预测未来状态，这限制了它们捕获轨迹条件下的场景演变的能力，并导致不可靠的动作规划。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了DynFlowDrive，一个利用基于流的动力学来建模不同驾驶动作下世界状态转移的潜在世界模型。通过采用矫正流公式，该模型学习了一个速度场，该速度场描述了场景状态在不同驾驶动作下的变化方式，从而能够逐步预测未来的潜在状态。在此基础上，我们进一步引入了一种稳定性感知的多模式轨迹选择策略，根据诱导的场景转换的稳定性来评估候选轨迹。在nuScenes和NavSim基准上的大量实验表明，在各种驾驶框架中都取得了持续的改进，且没有引入额外的推理开销。源代码将在https://github.com/xiaolul2/DynFlowDrive 上提供。

Authors: Xiaolu Liu, Yicong Li, Song Wang, Junbo Chen, Angela Yao, Jianke Zhu

ContractionPPO: Certified Reinforcement Learning via Differentiable Contraction Layers

简要说明：ContractionPPO通过可微收缩度量层增强了PPO算法，实现了腿式机器人的可认证鲁棒控制，并在硬件实验中证明了即使在强烈扰动下也能保持可认证的稳定性。

TLDR: ContractionPPO enhances PPO with a differentiable contraction metric layer for certified robust control of legged robots, demonstrating certifiable stability in hardware experiments even under strong perturbations.

Abstract: Legged locomotion in unstructured environments demands not only high-performance control policies but also formal guarantees to ensure robustness under perturbations. Control methods often require carefully designed reference trajectories, which are challenging to construct in high-dimensional, contact-rich systems such as quadruped robots. In contrast, Reinforcement Learning (RL) directly learns policies that implicitly generate motion, and uniquely benefits from access to privileged information, such as full state and dynamics during training, that is not available at deployment. We present ContractionPPO, a framework for certified robust planning and control of legged robots by augmenting Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) RL with a state-dependent contraction metric layer. This approach enables the policy to maximize performance while simultaneously producing a contraction metric that certifies incremental exponential stability of the simulated closed-loop system. The metric is parameterized as a Lipschitz neural network and trained jointly with the policy, either in parallel or as an auxiliary head of the PPO backbone. While the contraction metric is not deployed during real-world execution, we derive upper bounds on the worst-case contraction rate and show that these bounds ensure the learned contraction metric generalizes from simulation to real-world deployment. Our hardware experiments on quadruped locomotion demonstrate that ContractionPPO enables robust, certifiably stable control even under strong external perturbations.

摘要（中文）：在非结构化环境中进行足式运动不仅需要高性能的控制策略，还需要正式的保证来确保其在扰动下的鲁棒性。控制方法通常需要精心设计的参考轨迹，但在高维度、接触丰富的系统中（例如四足机器人）构建这些轨迹极具挑战性。相比之下，强化学习（RL）直接学习隐式生成运动的策略，并独特地受益于访问特权信息的机会，例如训练期间可用的完整状态和动力学，而这些信息在部署时不可用。我们提出了 ContractionPPO，这是一个用于腿式机器人认证鲁棒规划和控制的框架，它通过使用状态相关的压缩度量层来增强近端策略优化（PPO）RL。该方法使策略能够在最大化性能的同时，生成一个压缩度量，从而认证模拟闭环系统增量指数稳定性。该度量被参数化为 Lipschitz 神经网络，并与策略联合训练，可以并行训练，也可以作为 PPO 主干的辅助头部训练。虽然压缩度量在现实世界执行期间不部署，但我们推导了最坏情况压缩率的上限，并表明这些上限确保了学习到的压缩度量能够从仿真推广到现实世界部署。我们在四足运动硬件实验表明，即使在强大的外部扰动下，ContractionPPO 也能实现鲁棒、可证明稳定的控制。

Authors: Vrushabh Zinage, Narek Harutyunyan, Eric Verheyden, Fred Y. Hadaegh, Soon-Jo Chung

CeRLP: A Cross-embodiment Robot Local Planning Framework for Visual Navigation

简要说明：该论文介绍了一个名为CeRLP的跨具身机器人局部规划框架，它使用几何公式和深度估计尺度校正，使视觉导航能够在具有不同配置的机器人上进行，并在仿真和真实世界实验中表现出强大的性能。

TLDR: The paper introduces CeRLP, a novel cross-embodiment robot local planning framework that uses a geometric formulation and depth estimation scale correction to enable visual navigation across robots with varying configurations, showing strong performance in both simulation and real-world experiments.

Abstract: Visual navigation for cross-embodiment robots is challenging due to variations in robot and camera configurations, which can lead to the failure of navigation tasks. Previous approaches typically rely on collecting massive datasets across different robots, which is highly data-intensive, or fine-tuning models, which is time-consuming. Furthermore, both methods often lack explicit consideration of robot geometry. In this paper, we propose a Cross-embodiment Robot Local Planning (CeRLP) framework for general visual navigation, which abstracts visual information into a unified geometric formulation and applies to heterogeneous robots with varying physical dimensions, camera parameters, and camera types. CeRLP introduces a depth estimation scale correction method that utilizes offline pre-calibration to resolve the scale ambiguity of monocular depth estimation, thereby recovering precise metric depth images. Furthermore, CeRLP designs a visual-to-scan abstraction module that projects varying visual inputs into height-adaptive laser scans, making the policy robust to heterogeneous robots. Experiments in simulation environments demonstrate that CeRLP outperforms comparative methods, validating its robust obstacle avoidance capabilities as a local planner. Additionally, extensive real-world experiments verify the effectiveness of CeRLP in tasks such as point-to-point navigation and vision-language navigation, demonstrating its generalization across varying robot and camera configurations.

摘要（中文）：跨形态机器人视觉导航面临挑战，因为机器人和相机配置的差异会导致导航任务失败。以往的方法通常依赖于收集跨不同机器人的大规模数据集，这需要大量数据，或者微调模型，这非常耗时。此外，这两种方法通常都缺乏对机器人几何结构的明确考虑。本文提出了一种用于通用视觉导航的跨形态机器人局部规划（CeRLP）框架，该框架将视觉信息抽象为统一的几何公式，并适用于具有不同物理尺寸、相机参数和相机类型的异构机器人。CeRLP引入了一种深度估计尺度校正方法，利用离线预校准来解决单目深度估计的尺度模糊性，从而恢复精确的度量深度图像。此外，CeRLP设计了一个视觉到扫描抽象模块，将不同的视觉输入投影到高度自适应的激光扫描中，使策略对异构机器人具有鲁棒性。仿真环境中的实验表明，CeRLP优于对比方法，验证了其作为局部规划器的鲁棒避障能力。此外，大量的真实世界实验验证了CeRLP在点到点导航和视觉-语言导航等任务中的有效性，证明了其在不同机器人和相机配置上的泛化能力。

Authors: Haoyu Xi, Mingao Tan, Xinming Zhang, Siwei Cheng, Shanze Wang, Yin Gu, Xiaoyu Shen, Wei Zhang

Can LLMs Prove Robotic Path Planning Optimality? A Benchmark for Research-Level Algorithm Verification

简要说明：这篇论文提出了一个基准，用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）证明机器人路径规划算法近似最优性的能力。研究发现，虽然当前的大型语言模型面临挑战，但特定于任务的提示可以显著提高性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on their ability to prove the approximation-ratio optimality of robotic path planning algorithms and finds that while current LLMs struggle, task-specific prompts help substantially.

Abstract: Robotic path planning problems are often NP-hard, and practical solutions typically rely on approximation algorithms with provable performance guarantees for general cases. While designing such algorithms is challenging, formally proving their approximation optimality is even more demanding, which requires domain-specific geometric insights and multi-step mathematical reasoning over complex operational constraints. Recent Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, yet their ability to assist with research-level optimality proofs in robotic path planning remains under-explored. In this work, we introduce the first benchmark for evaluating LLMs on approximation-ratio proofs of robotic path planning algorithms. The benchmark consists of 34 research-grade proof tasks spanning diverse planning problem types and complexity levels, each requiring structured reasoning over algorithm descriptions, problem constraints, and theoretical guarantees. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art proprietary and open-source LLMs reveals that even the strongest models struggle to produce fully valid proofs without external domain knowledge. However, providing LLMs with task-specific in-context lemmas substantially improves reasoning quality, a factor that is more effective than generic chain-of-thought prompting or supplying the ground-truth approximation ratio as posterior knowledge. We further provide fine-grained error analysis to characterize common logical failures and hallucinations, and demonstrate how each error type can be mitigated through targeted context augmentation.

摘要（中文）：机器人路径规划问题通常是NP难的，实际解决方案通常依赖于近似算法，这些算法具有针对一般情况的可证明的性能保证。设计此类算法具有挑战性，而正式证明其近似最优性则更具挑战性，这需要领域特定的几何见解以及对复杂操作约束的多步骤数学推理。最近的大型语言模型（LLMs）在数学推理基准测试中表现出强大的性能，但它们在机器人路径规划中辅助研究级别最优性证明的能力仍未得到充分探索。在这项工作中，我们引入了第一个评估LLMs在机器人路径规划算法的近似比证明方面的基准。该基准包含34个研究级别的证明任务，涵盖不同的规划问题类型和复杂性级别，每个任务都需要对算法描述、问题约束和理论保证进行结构化推理。我们对最先进的专有和开源LLM的评估表明，即使是最强大的模型也难以在没有外部领域知识的情况下产生完全有效的证明。然而，为LLM提供特定于任务的上下文引理可以显著提高推理质量，这一因素比通用思维链提示或提供真值近似比作为后验知识更有效。我们进一步提供了细粒度的错误分析，以描述常见的逻辑错误和幻觉，并展示了如何通过有针对性的上下文增强来缓解每种错误类型。

Authors: Zhengbang Yang, Md. Tasin Tazwar, Minghan Wei, Zhuangdi Zhu

Speculative Policy Orchestration: A Latency-Resilient Framework for Cloud-Robotic Manipulation

简要说明：本文介绍了一种名为推测策略编排（SPO）的延迟弹性云边框架，用于云机器人技术。SPO利用云托管的世界模型、预先计算的运动学航路点和一个误差界定验证器，以改善网络延迟下的连续操作任务。结果表明，SPO减少了网络引起的空闲时间，并比基线方法丢弃的预测更少。

TLDR: The paper introduces Speculative Policy Orchestration (SPO), a latency-resilient cloud-edge framework for cloud robotics that uses a cloud-hosted world model, pre-computed kinematic waypoints, and an error-bounding verifier to improve continuous manipulation tasks under network delays. Results show SPO reduces network-induced idle time and discards fewer predictions than baselines.

Abstract: Cloud robotics enables robots to offload high-dimensional motion planning and reasoning to remote servers. However, for continuous manipulation tasks requiring high-frequency control, network latency and jitter can severely destabilize the system, causing command starvation and unsafe physical execution. To address this, we propose Speculative Policy Orchestration (SPO), a latency-resilient cloud-edge framework. SPO utilizes a cloud-hosted world model to pre-compute and stream future kinematic waypoints to a local edge buffer, decoupling execution frequency from network round-trip time. To mitigate unsafe execution caused by predictive drift, the edge node employs an $ε$-tube verifier that strictly bounds kinematic execution errors. The framework is coupled with an Adaptive Horizon Scaling mechanism that dynamically expands or shrinks the speculative pre-fetch depth based on real-time tracking error. We evaluate SPO on continuous RLBench manipulation tasks under emulated network delays. Results show that even when deployed with learned models of modest accuracy, SPO reduces network-induced idle time by over 60% compared to blocking remote inference. Furthermore, SPO discards approximately 60% fewer cloud predictions than static caching baselines. Ultimately, SPO enables fluid, real-time cloud-robotic control while maintaining bounded physical safety.

摘要（中文）：云机器人技术使得机器人能够将高维度运动规划和推理任务卸载到远程服务器。然而，对于需要高频率控制的连续操作任务，网络延迟和抖动会严重破坏系统稳定性，导致指令匮乏和不安全的物理执行。 为了解决这个问题，我们提出了推测性策略编排（SPO），一种具有延迟弹性的云边框架。SPO利用云端托管的世界模型预先计算并将未来的运动学航路点流式传输到本地边缘缓冲器，从而将执行频率与网络往返时间解耦。为了减轻由预测漂移导致的不安全执行，边缘节点采用了一个 $ε$-管验证器来严格约束运动学执行误差。该框架与一个自适应范围缩放机制相结合，该机制基于实时跟踪误差动态地扩展或缩小推测性预取深度。 我们在模拟网络延迟下，对连续的RLBench操作任务评估SPO。结果表明，即使在使用精度适中的学习模型进行部署时，与阻塞式远程推理相比，SPO也能减少网络引起的空闲时间超过60%。此外，SPO丢弃的云预测数量比静态缓存基线少大约60%。最终，SPO实现了流畅、实时的云机器人控制，同时保持有界的物理安全性。

Authors: Chanh Nguyen, Shutong Jin, Florian T. Pokorny, Erik Elmroth

VAMPO: Policy Optimization for Improving Visual Dynamics in Video Action Models

简要说明：VAMPO通过优化一个基于专家视觉动态奖励的去噪策略，改进视频动作模型中的视觉动力学，从而在操纵任务中实现更好的下游动作生成和泛化。

TLDR: VAMPO improves visual dynamics in video action models by optimizing a denoising policy with rewards based on expert visual dynamics, leading to better downstream action generation and generalization in manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Video action models are an appealing foundation for Vision--Language--Action systems because they can learn visual dynamics from large-scale video data and transfer this knowledge to downstream robot control. Yet current diffusion-based video predictors are trained with likelihood-surrogate objectives, which encourage globally plausible predictions without explicitly optimizing the precision-critical visual dynamics needed for manipulation. This objective mismatch often leads to subtle errors in object pose, spatial relations, and contact timing that can be amplified by downstream policies. We propose VAMPO, a post-training framework that directly improves visual dynamics in video action models through policy optimization. Our key idea is to formulate multi-step denoising as a sequential decision process and optimize the denoising policy with rewards defined over expert visual dynamics in latent space. To make this optimization practical, we introduce an Euler Hybrid sampler that injects stochasticity only at the first denoising step, enabling tractable low-variance policy-gradient estimation while preserving the coherence of the remaining denoising trajectory. We further combine this design with GRPO and a verifiable non-adversarial reward. Across diverse simulated and real-world manipulation tasks, VAMPO improves task-relevant visual dynamics, leading to better downstream action generation and stronger generalization. The homepage is https://vampo-robot.github.io/VAMPO/.

摘要（中文）：视频动作模型是视觉-语言-动作系统的一个吸引人的基础，因为它们可以从大规模视频数据中学习视觉动态，并将这种知识迁移到下游机器人控制。然而，目前基于扩散的视频预测器使用似然替代目标进行训练，这种目标鼓励全局上合理的预测，而没有明确优化操作所需要的精度关键的视觉动态。这种目标不匹配通常会导致物体姿态，空间关系和接触时序上的细微错误，这些错误会被下游策略放大。我们提出了VAMPO，一个后训练框架，通过策略优化直接提升视频动作模型中的视觉动态。我们的核心思想是将多步去噪过程形式化为一个序贯决策过程，并利用在潜在空间中定义的基于专家视觉动态的奖励来优化去噪策略。为了使这种优化可行，我们引入了一种欧拉混合采样器，仅在第一个去噪步骤注入随机性，从而实现可处理的低方差策略梯度估计，同时保持剩余去噪轨迹的连贯性。我们进一步将这种设计与GRPO和可验证的非对抗性奖励相结合。在各种模拟和现实世界的操作任务中，VAMPO改善了与任务相关的视觉动态，从而促进了更好的下游动作生成和更强的泛化能力。项目主页是https://vampo-robot.github.io/VAMPO/。

Authors: Zirui Ge, Pengxiang Ding, Baohua Yin, Qishen Wang, Zhiyong Xie, Yemin Wang, Jinbo Wang, Hengtao Li, Runze Suo, Wenxuan Song, Han Zhao, Shangke Lyu, Zhaoxin Fan, Haoang Li, Ran Cheng, Cheng Chi, Huibin Ge, Yaozhi Luo, Donglin Wang

VideoSeek: Long-Horizon Video Agent with Tool-Guided Seeking

简要说明：VideoSeek是一种视频Agent，它通过在思考-行动-观察循环中使用工具包来主动寻找视频中回答关键证据，与现有方法相比，通过解析更少的帧，实现了更高的准确性和效率。

TLDR: VideoSeek is a video agent that actively seeks answer-critical evidence in videos using a toolkit within a think-act-observe loop, achieving improved accuracy and efficiency compared to existing methods by parsing far fewer frames.

Abstract: Video agentic models have advanced challenging video-language tasks. However, most agentic approaches still heavily rely on greedy parsing over densely sampled video frames, resulting in high computational cost. We present VideoSeek, a long-horizon video agent that leverages video logic flow to actively seek answer-critical evidence instead of exhaustively parsing the full video. This insight allows the model to use far fewer frames while maintaining, or even improving, its video understanding capability. VideoSeek operates in a think-act-observe loop with a well-designed toolkit for collecting multi-granular video observations. This design enables query-aware exploration over accumulated observations and supports practical video understanding and reasoning. Experiments on four challenging video understanding and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that VideoSeek achieves strong accuracy while using far fewer frames than prior video agents and standalone LMMs. Notably, VideoSeek achieves a 10.2 absolute points improvement on LVBench over its base model, GPT-5, while using 93% fewer frames. Further analysis highlights the significance of leveraging video logic flow, strong reasoning capability, and the complementary roles of toolkit design.

摘要（中文）：视频代理模型在具有挑战性的视频-语言任务中取得了进展。然而，大多数代理方法仍然严重依赖于对密集采样的视频帧进行贪婪解析，导致计算成本很高。我们提出了VideoSeek，一种长程视频代理，它利用视频逻辑流来主动寻找对回答至关重要的证据，而不是穷尽式地解析整个视频。这种洞察力使得模型能够用远少于以往的帧数，同时保持甚至提高其视频理解能力。VideoSeek 通过一个精心设计的工具包，以思考-行动-观察的循环方式运行，用于收集多粒度的视频观察结果。这种设计能够对累积的观察结果进行查询感知的探索，并支持实际的视频理解和推理。在四个具有挑战性的视频理解和推理基准测试上的实验表明，VideoSeek 在使用远少于先前的视频代理和独立的LMM的帧数的情况下，实现了强大的准确性。值得注意的是，VideoSeek 在 LVBench 上比其基础模型GPT-5提升了10.2个绝对百分点，同时使用的帧数减少了93%。进一步的分析突出了利用视频逻辑流、强大的推理能力以及工具包设计的互补作用的重要性。

Authors: Jingyang Lin, Jialian Wu, Jiang Liu, Ximeng Sun, Ze Wang, Xiaodong Yu, Jiebo Luo, Zicheng Liu, Emad Barsoum

Learning Dynamic Belief Graphs for Theory-of-mind Reasoning

简要说明：本文介绍了一种动态信念图模型，旨在提升基于大型语言模型（LLM）的心理理论（ToM）推理能力，特别是在动态、高风险场景下。该模型通过真实世界的灾难疏散数据集，显著提高了动作预测和信念轨迹恢复的准确性。

TLDR: This paper introduces a dynamic belief graph model to enhance LLM-based Theory of Mind (ToM) reasoning in dynamic, high-stakes situations. It improves action prediction and belief trajectory recovery using real-world disaster evacuation datasets.

Abstract: Theory of Mind (ToM) reasoning with Large Language Models (LLMs) requires inferring how people's implicit, evolving beliefs shape what they seek and how they act under uncertainty -- especially in high-stakes settings such as disaster response, emergency medicine, and human-in-the-loop autonomy. Prior approaches either prompt LLMs directly or use latent-state models that treat beliefs as static and independent, often producing incoherent mental models over time and weak reasoning in dynamic contexts. We introduce a structured cognitive trajectory model for LLM-based ToM that represents mental state as a dynamic belief graph, jointly inferring latent beliefs, learning their time-varying dependencies, and linking belief evolution to information seeking and decisions. Our model contributes (i) a novel projection from textualized probabilistic statements to consistent probabilistic graphical model updates, (ii) an energy-based factor graph representation of belief interdependencies, and (iii) an ELBO-based objective that captures belief accumulation and delayed decisions. Across multiple real-world disaster evacuation datasets, our model significantly improves action prediction and recovers interpretable belief trajectories consistent with human reasoning, providing a principled module for augmenting LLMs with ToM in high-uncertainty environment. https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ICML_submission-6373/

摘要（中文）：利用大型语言模型（LLM）进行心理理论（ToM）推理需要推断人们隐式的、不断演变的信念如何塑造他们寻求什么以及他们在不确定性下的行为方式——尤其是在灾害响应、急诊医学和人机协同自主等高风险环境中。以往的方法要么直接提示LLM，要么使用将信念视为静态且独立的隐状态模型，这通常会随着时间的推移产生不连贯的心理模型并导致在动态上下文中的较弱推理能力。我们引入了一种基于LLM的ToM的结构化认知轨迹模型，该模型将心理状态表示为动态信念图，联合推断潜在信念，学习其随时间变化的依赖关系，并将信念演变与信息寻求和决策联系起来。 我们的模型贡献了：（i）一种从文本化的概率陈述到一致的概率图模型更新的新颖投影，（ii）一种基于能量的信念相互依赖关系的因子图表示，以及（iii）一种基于ELBO的目标，该目标捕获信念积累和延迟决策。在多个真实世界的灾害疏散数据集中，我们的模型显著提高了行动预测能力，并恢复了与人类推理相一致的可解释的信念轨迹，为在高不确定性环境中用ToM增强LLM提供了一个原则性模块。 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ICML_submission-6373/

Authors: Ruxiao Chen, Xilei Zhao, Thomas J. Cova, Frank A. Drews, Susu Xu

Chain-of-Adaptation: Surgical Vision-Language Adaptation with Reinforcement Learning

简要说明：该论文介绍了链式适应(CoA)，一种强化学习框架，通过保持预训练知识和增强领域对齐来调整视觉语言模型(VLMs)以适应外科任务，从而提高准确性和泛化能力。CoA通过仔细选择微调期间要更新的参数来防止适应过程中的灾难性遗忘。

TLDR: The paper introduces Chain-of-Adaptation (CoA), a reinforcement learning framework that adapts Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for surgical tasks by preserving pre-trained knowledge and enhancing domain alignment, resulting in improved accuracy and generalization. CoA prevents catastrophic forgetting during adaptation by carefully selecting which parameters to update during fine-tuning.

Abstract: Conventional fine-tuning on domain-specific datasets can inadvertently alter a model's pretrained multimodal priors, leading to reduced generalization. To address this, we propose Chain-of-Adaptation (CoA), an adaptation framework designed to integrate domain knowledge while maintaining the model's inherent reasoning and perceptual capabilities. CoA introduces a structured reasoning format that enhances domain alignment without sacrificing general multimodal competence by reinforcement learning. Experiments on standard surgical benchmarks, under both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings, demonstrate that CoA achieves higher accuracy, stronger generalization, and more stable behavior than supervised fine-tuning. Furthermore, ablation studies confirm that CoA effectively preserves the model's core visual-language abilities, providing a reliable pathway for domain specialization in VLMs.

摘要（中文）：在特定领域数据集上进行传统微调可能会无意中改变模型预训练的多模态先验知识，导致泛化能力降低。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种适应框架Chain-of-Adaptation (CoA)，旨在整合领域知识，同时保持模型固有的推理和感知能力。CoA引入了一种结构化的推理格式，通过强化学习来增强领域对齐，而不会牺牲一般的多模态能力。在标准的手术基准测试中，无论是在分布内还是分布外设置下，实验结果表明 CoA 比监督微调实现了更高的准确率、更强的泛化能力和更稳定的行为。此外，消融研究证实 CoA 有效地保留了模型的核心视觉-语言能力，为 VLM 中的领域专业化提供了一条可靠的途径。

Authors: Jiajie Li, Chenhui Xu, Meihuan Liu, Jinjun Xiong

Experience is the Best Teacher: Motivating Effective Exploration in Reinforcement Learning for LLMs

简要说明：该论文介绍了一种名为HeRL的强化学习框架，它利用后见之明经验（失败的轨迹和未满足的规则）作为上下文指导，以改善LLM的探索，并在各种基准测试中实现了卓越的性能。

TLDR: The paper introduces HeRL, a reinforcement learning framework that uses hindsight experience (failed trajectories and unmet rubrics) as in-context guidance to improve exploration for LLMs, achieving superior performance on various benchmarks.

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) with rubric-based rewards has recently shown remarkable progress in enhancing general reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet still suffers from ineffective exploration confined to curent policy distribution. In fact, RL optimization can be viewed as steering the policy toward an ideal distribution that maximizes the rewards, while effective exploration should align efforts with desired target. Leveraging this insight, we propose HeRL, a Hindsight experience guided Reinforcement Learning framework to bootstrap effective exploration by explicitly telling LLMs the desired behaviors specified in rewards. Concretely, HeRL treats failed trajectories along with their unmet rubrics as hindsight experience, which serves as in-context guidance for the policy to explore desired responses beyond its current distribution. Additionally, we introduce a bonus reward to incentivize responses with greater potential for improvement under such guidance. HeRL facilitates effective learning from desired high quality samples without repeated trial-and-error from scratch, yielding a more accurate estimation of the expected gradient theoretically. Extensive experiments across various benchmarks demonstrate that HeRL achieves superior performance gains over baselines, and can further benefit from experience guided self-improvement at test time. Our code is available at https://github.com/sikelifei/HeRL.

摘要（中文）：基于评估准则奖励的强化学习（RL）最近在提升大型语言模型（LLM）的通用推理能力方面取得了显著进展，但仍然受到限于当前策略分布的低效探索的困扰。事实上，RL优化可以被视为引导策略朝着最大化奖励的理想分布前进，而有效的探索应该将努力与期望的目标对齐。基于此洞察，我们提出HeRL，一种后见之明经验引导的强化学习框架，通过明确告诉LLM奖励中指定的期望行为来引导高效探索。具体而言，HeRL将失败的轨迹及其未满足的评估准则视为后见之明经验，作为策略的上下文提示，以探索超出其当前分布的期望响应。此外，我们引入了一种奖励加成，以激励在这种提示下更具改进潜力的响应。HeRL促进了从期望的高质量样本中进行有效学习，避免了从零开始的重复试错，从而在理论上产生更准确的期望梯度估计。在各种基准测试上的大量实验表明，HeRL相比基线实现了卓越的性能提升，并且可以在测试时进一步受益于经验引导的自我改进。我们的代码可在https://github.com/sikelifei/HeRL获得。

Authors: Wenjian Zhang, Kongcheng Zhang, Jiaxin Qi, Baisheng Lai, Jianqiang Huang

What If Consensus Lies? Selective-Complementary Reinforcement Learning at Test Time

简要说明：该论文介绍了SCRL，一种测试时强化学习方法，该方法使用选择性积极和熵门控消极伪标记，通过减轻挑战性场景中弱共识产生的标签噪声来提高LLM的推理能力。

TLDR: This paper introduces SCRL, a test-time reinforcement learning method that uses both selective positive and entropy-gated negative pseudo-labeling to improve LLM reasoning by mitigating label noise from weak consensus in challenging scenarios.

Abstract: Test-Time Reinforcement Learning (TTRL) enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to enhance reasoning capabilities on unlabeled test streams by deriving pseudo-rewards from majority voting consensus. However, existing TTRL methods rely exclusively on positive pseudo-labeling strategies. Such reliance becomes vulnerable under challenging scenarios where answer distributions are highly dispersed, resulting in weak consensus that inadvertently reinforces incorrect trajectories as supervision signals. In this paper, we propose SCRL (Selective-Complementary Reinforcement Learning), a robust test-time reinforcement learning framework that effectively mitigates label noise amplification. SCRL develops Selective Positive Pseudo-Labeling, which enforces strict consensus criteria to filter unreliable majorities. Complementarily, SCRL introduces Entropy-Gated Negative Pseudo-Labeling, the first negative supervision mechanism in TTRL, to reliably prune incorrect trajectories based on generation uncertainty. Extensive experiments on multiple reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that SCRL achieves substantial improvements over baselines, while maintaining robust generalization and training stability under constrained rollout budgets. Our code is available at https://github.com/Jasper-Yan/SCRL.

摘要（中文）：测试时强化学习(TTRL)使大型语言模型(LLMs)能够通过从多数投票共识中导出伪奖励来增强未标记测试流的推理能力。然而，现有的TTRL方法完全依赖于正伪标签策略。这种依赖性在答案分布高度分散的具有挑战性的场景下变得脆弱，导致微弱的共识，无意中将不正确的轨迹强化为监督信号。在本文中，我们提出了SCRL（选择性-互补强化学习），一个鲁棒的测试时强化学习框架，能有效缓解标签噪声放大问题。SCRL开发了选择性正伪标签，它强制执行严格的共识标准来过滤不可靠的多数。作为补充，SCRL引入了熵门控负伪标签，这是TTRL中首个负监督机制，它基于生成的不确定性来可靠地剪枝不正确的轨迹。在多个推理基准上的大量实验表明，SCRL相对于基线方法取得了显著的改进，同时在受约束的Rollout预算下保持了鲁棒的泛化能力和训练稳定性。我们的代码可在https://github.com/Jasper-Yan/SCRL获取。

Authors: Dong Yan, Jian Liang, Yanbo Wang, Shuo Lu, Ran He, Tieniu Tan

Failure Modes for Deep Learning-Based Online Mapping: How to Measure and Address Them

简要说明：本文提出一个框架，用于识别和减轻基于深度学习的在线地图构建中的失败模式，通过解耦记忆和过拟合，并提出数据集诊断和稀疏化策略，以提高模型的泛化能力和性能，尤其是在几何多样化的环境中。

TLDR: This paper introduces a framework to identify and mitigate failure modes in deep learning-based online mapping by disentangling memorization and overfitting, and proposes dataset diagnostics and sparsification strategies to improve model generalization and performance, particularly on geometry-diverse environments.

Abstract: Deep learning-based online mapping has emerged as a cornerstone of autonomous driving, yet these models frequently fail to generalize beyond familiar environments. We propose a framework to identify and measure the underlying failure modes by disentangling two effects: Memorization of input features and overfitting to known map geometries. We propose measures based on evaluation subsets that control for geographical proximity and geometric similarity between training and validation scenes. We introduce Fréchet distance-based reconstruction statistics that capture per-element shape fidelity without threshold tuning, and define complementary failure-mode scores: a localization overfitting score quantifying the performance drop when geographic cues disappear, and a map geometry overfitting score measuring degradation as scenes become geometrically novel. Beyond models, we analyze dataset biases and contribute map geometry-aware diagnostics: A minimum-spanning-tree (MST) diversity measure for training sets and a symmetric coverage measure to quantify geometric similarity between splits. Leveraging these, we formulate an MST-based sparsification strategy that reduces redundancy and improves balancing and performance while shrinking training size. Experiments on nuScenes and Argoverse 2 across multiple state-of-the-art models yield more trustworthy assessment of generalization and show that map geometry-diverse and balanced training sets lead to improved performance. Our results motivate failure-mode-aware protocols and map geometry-centric dataset design for deployable online mapping.

摘要（中文）：基于深度学习的在线地图构建已成为自动驾驶的基石，但这些模型通常无法推广到熟悉的环境之外。我们提出一个框架，通过解耦两种效应来识别和衡量底层失效模式：输入特征的记忆和对已知地图几何形状的过拟合。我们提出基于评估子集的度量，用于控制训练场景和验证场景之间的地理邻近性和几何相似性。我们引入基于Fréchet距离的重建统计量，在无需阈值调整的情况下捕获逐元素形状保真度，并定义互补的失效模式评分：一个定位过拟合评分，量化了地理线索消失时的性能下降；以及一个地图几何形状过拟合评分，衡量了场景变得几何新颖时的退化。除了模型之外，我们还分析了数据集偏差，并贡献了地图几何形状感知的诊断方法：用于训练集的最小生成树（MST）多样性度量，以及用于量化分割之间几何相似性的对称覆盖度量。利用这些，我们制定了一种基于MST的稀疏化策略，可以在缩小训练规模的同时减少冗余，改善平衡和性能。在nuScenes和Argoverse 2上对多个最先进模型的实验表明，可以对泛化进行更可信的评估，并表明地图几何形状多样且平衡的训练集可以提高性能。我们的结果激发了失效模式感知协议和以地图几何形状为中心的数据集设计，以实现可部署的在线地图构建。

Authors: Michael Hubbertz, Qi Han, Tobias Meisen

Embodied Science: Closing the Discovery Loop with Agentic Embodied AI

简要说明：这篇论文提出了“具身科学”，一个闭环的科学发现框架(PLAD)，它整合了基于代理的推理和物理执行，旨在生命科学和化学科学中实现自主发现。

TLDR: This paper proposes 'Embodied Science,' a closed-loop framework (PLAD) for scientific discovery that integrates agent-based reasoning and physical execution, aiming for autonomous discovery in life and chemical sciences.

Abstract: Artificial intelligence has demonstrated remarkable capability in predicting scientific properties, yet scientific discovery remains an inherently physical, long-horizon pursuit governed by experimental cycles. Most current computational approaches are misaligned with this reality, framing discovery as isolated, task-specific predictions rather than continuous interaction with the physical world. Here, we argue for embodied science, a paradigm that reframes scientific discovery as a closed loop tightly coupling agentic reasoning with physical execution. We propose a unified Perception-Language-Action-Discovery (PLAD) framework, wherein embodied agents perceive experimental environments, reason over scientific knowledge, execute physical interventions, and internalize outcomes to drive subsequent exploration. By grounding computational reasoning in robust physical feedback, this approach bridges the gap between digital prediction and empirical validation, offering a roadmap for autonomous discovery systems in the life and chemical sciences.

摘要（中文）：人工智能在预测科学特性方面展现出卓越的能力，然而科学发现本质上是一种受实验循环支配的物理性的、长周期的探索。目前大多数计算方法与这种现实不符，它们将发现视为孤立的、特定于任务的预测，而非与物理世界的持续互动。在此，我们提出具身科学这一范式，它将科学发现重新定义为一个紧密耦合能动推理与物理执行的闭环。我们提出了一个统一的感知-语言-行动-发现（PLAD）框架，其中具身智能体感知实验环境，基于科学知识进行推理，执行物理干预，并将结果内化以驱动后续的探索。通过将计算推理建立在可靠的物理反馈之上，该方法弥合了数字预测和经验验证之间的差距，为生命科学和化学领域的自主发现系统提供了一条路线图。

Authors: Xiang Zhuang, Chenyi Zhou, Kehua Feng, Zhihui Zhu, Yunfan Gao, Yijie Zhong, Yichi Zhang, Junjie Huang, Keyan Ding, Lei Bai, Haofen Wang, Qiang Zhang, Huajun Chen

A Subgoal-driven Framework for Improving Long-Horizon LLM Agents

简要说明：本文提出了一个由子目标驱动的框架（MiRA），结合在线规划和基于里程碑的强化学习，显著提高了LLM智能体在长周期网络导航任务中的成功率，超过了GPT-4模型和之前的SOTA开源模型。

TLDR: This paper introduces a subgoal-driven framework (MiRA) combining online planning with milestone-based RL to significantly improve the success rate of LLM agents in long-horizon web navigation tasks, surpassing GPT-4 models and the previous SOTA open-source model.

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents have emerged as powerful autonomous controllers for digital environments, including mobile interfaces, operating systems, and web browsers. Web navigation, for example, requires handling dynamic content and long sequences of actions, making it particularly challenging. Existing LLM-based agents struggle with long-horizon planning in two main ways. During online execution, they often lose track as new information arrives, lacking a clear and adaptive path toward the final goal. This issue is further exacerbated during reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning, where sparse and delayed rewards make it difficult for agents to identify which actions lead to success, preventing them from maintaining coherent reasoning over extended tasks. To address these challenges, we propose two contributions. First, we introduce an agent framework that leverages proprietary models for online planning through subgoal decomposition. Second, we present MiRA (Milestoning your Reinforcement Learning Enhanced Agent), an RL training framework that uses dense, milestone-based reward signals. The real-time planning mechanism improves proprietary models such as Gemini by approximately a 10% absolute increase in success rate (SR) on the WebArena-Lite benchmark. Meanwhile, applying MiRA to the open Gemma3-12B model increases its success rate from 6.4% to 43.0%. This performance surpasses proprietary systems such as GPT-4-Turbo (17.6%) and GPT-4o (13.9%), as well as the previous open-model state of the art, WebRL (38.4%). Overall, our findings demonstrate that combining explicit inference-time planning with milestone-based rewards significantly improves an agent's long-horizon capabilities, paving the way for more robust and general-purpose autonomous systems.

摘要（中文）：基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体已经成为数字环境（包括移动界面、操作系统和Web浏览器）中强大的自主控制器。例如，Web导航需要处理动态内容和长序列动作，使其极具挑战性。现有的基于LLM的智能体在长程规划方面面临两个主要困难。在线执行期间，它们经常在接收到新信息时失去对目标的追踪，缺乏通往最终目标的清晰且自适应的路径。在强化学习（RL）微调期间，这个问题进一步加剧，稀疏且延迟的奖励使得智能体难以识别哪些动作导向成功，从而阻碍了它们在扩展任务中保持连贯的推理。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了两项贡献。首先，我们引入了一个智能体框架，该框架利用专有模型通过子目标分解进行在线规划。其次，我们提出了MiRA（Milestoning your Reinforcement Learning Enhanced Agent），这是一个使用密集、基于里程碑的奖励信号的RL训练框架。通过子目标分解的实时规划机制使诸如Gemini等专有模型在WebArena-Lite基准测试上的成功率（SR）提高了约10%。同时，将MiRA应用于开源Gemma3-12B模型，使其成功率从6.4%提升至43.0%。这一性能超越了诸如GPT-4-Turbo（17.6%）和GPT-4o（13.9%）等专有系统，以及之前的开源模型state of the art，WebRL（38.4%）。总而言之，我们的研究结果表明，将显式的推理时规划与基于里程碑的奖励相结合可以显著提高智能体的长程能力，为更强大和通用的自主系统铺平道路。

Authors: Taiyi Wang, Sian Gooding, Florian Hartmann, Oriana Riva, Edward Grefenstette

GoAgent: Group-of-Agents Communication Topology Generation for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems

简要说明：GoAgent 提出了一种新颖的方法，通过显式建模和连接协作组来生成基于LLM的多智能体系统的通信拓扑，并通过条件信息瓶颈提高准确性并减少 token 消耗。

TLDR: GoAgent introduces a novel approach to generating communication topologies for LLM-based multi-agent systems by explicitly modeling and connecting collaborative groups, improving accuracy and reducing token consumption through a conditional information bottleneck.

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have demonstrated exceptional capabilities in solving complex tasks, yet their effectiveness depends heavily on the underlying communication topology that coordinates agent interactions. Within these systems, successful problem-solving often necessitates task-specific group structures to divide and conquer subtasks. However, most existing approaches generate communication topologies in a node-centric manner, leaving group structures to emerge implicitly from local connectivity decisions rather than modeling them explicitly, often leading to suboptimal coordination and unnecessary communication overhead. To address this limitation, we propose GoAgent (Group-of-Agents), a communication topology generation method that explicitly treats collaborative groups as the atomic units of MAS construction. Specifically, GoAgent first enumerates task-relevant candidate groups through an LLM and then autoregressively selects and connects these groups as atomic units to construct the final communication graph, jointly capturing intra-group cohesion and inter-group coordination. To mitigate communication redundancy and noise propagation inherent in expanding topologies, we further introduce a conditional information bottleneck (CIB) objective that compresses inter-group communication, preserving task-relevant signals while filtering out redundant historical noise. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of GoAgent with 93.84% average accuracy while reducing token consumption by about 17%.

摘要（中文）：基于大型语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）在解决复杂任务方面表现出了卓越的能力，但其有效性很大程度上取决于协调智能体交互的底层通信拓扑结构。在这些系统中，成功的问题解决通常需要特定于任务的组结构来分解和 conquer 子任务。然而，大多数现有方法以节点为中心生成通信拓扑，导致组结构隐式地从局部连接决策中涌现出来，而不是显式地建模它们，这通常会导致次优的协作和不必要的通信开销。为了解决这个局限性，我们提出 GoAgent (智能体组)，一种将协作组显式地视为 MAS 构建的原子单元的通信拓扑生成方法。具体来说，GoAgent 首先通过 LLM 枚举与任务相关的候选组，然后自回归地选择和连接这些组作为原子单元来构建最终的通信图，共同捕捉组内凝聚力和组间协调。为了缓解扩展拓扑结构中固有的通信冗余和噪声传播，我们进一步引入了一个条件信息瓶颈（CIB）目标函数，用于压缩组间通信，在过滤掉冗余历史噪声的同时保留与任务相关的信号。在六个基准上的大量实验表明，GoAgent 具有最先进的性能，平均准确率达到 93.84%，同时token消耗降低约 17%。

Authors: Hongjiang Chen, Xin Zheng, Yixin Liu, Pengfei Jiao, Shiyuan Li, Huan Liu, Zhidong Zhao, Ziqi Xu, Ibrahim Khalil, Shirui Pan

HyEvo: Self-Evolving Hybrid Agentic Workflows for Efficient Reasoning

简要说明：HyEvo是一个自动生成混合代理工作流程的框架，结合了LLM和确定性代码，以提高推理任务的效率并降低成本，性能优于现有方法。

TLDR: HyEvo is a framework for automatically generating hybrid agentic workflows that combine LLMs and deterministic code to improve efficiency and reduce cost in reasoning tasks, outperforming existing methods.

Abstract: Although agentic workflows have demonstrated strong potential for solving complex tasks, existing automated generation methods remain inefficient and underperform, as they rely on predefined operator libraries and homogeneous LLM-only workflows in which all task-level computation is performed through probabilistic inference. To address these limitations, we propose HyEvo, an automated workflow-generation framework that leverages heterogeneous atomic synthesis. HyEvo integrates probabilistic LLM nodes for semantic reasoning with deterministic code nodes for rule-based execution, offloading predictable operations from LLM inference and reducing inference cost and execution latency. To efficiently navigate the hybrid search space, HyEvo employs an LLM-driven multi-island evolutionary strategy with a reflect-then-generate mechanism, iteratively refining both workflow topology and node logic via execution feedback. Comprehensive experiments show that HyEvo consistently outperforms existing methods across diverse reasoning and coding benchmarks, while reducing inference cost and execution latency by up to 19$\times$ and 16$\times$, respectively, compared to the state-of-the-art open-source baseline.

摘要（中文）：尽管主动工作流已显示出解决复杂任务的强大潜力，但现有的自动生成方法仍然效率低下且表现欠佳，因为它们依赖于预定义的操作符库和同质化的仅 LLM 工作流，其中所有任务级计算都通过概率推理执行。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了 HyEvo，一种利用异构原子合成的自动工作流生成框架。HyEvo 集成了用于语义推理的概率 LLM 节点和用于基于规则执行的确定性代码节点，从而将可预测的操作从 LLM 推理中卸载，并降低推理成本和执行延迟。为了有效地导航混合搜索空间，HyEvo 采用了一种 LLM 驱动的具有反射-生成机制的多岛演化策略，通过执行反馈迭代地优化工作流拓扑和节点逻辑。全面的实验表明，HyEvo 在各种推理和编码基准测试中始终优于现有方法，同时与最先进的开源基线相比，推理成本和执行延迟分别降低高达 19 倍和 16 倍。

Authors: Beibei Xu, Yutong Ye, Chuyun Shen, Yingbo Zhou, Cheng Chen, Mingsong Chen

Skilled AI Agents for Embedded and IoT Systems Development

简要说明：本文介绍了一个基于技能的代理框架和一个基准测试(IoT-SkillsBench)，用于评估在硬件在环嵌入式和物联网系统开发中的人工智能代理，并展示了通过人工专家定义的技能来提高成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces a skills-based agentic framework and benchmark (IoT-SkillsBench) for evaluating AI agents in hardware-in-the-loop embedded and IoT systems development, demonstrating improved success rates with human-expert defined skills.

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) and agentic systems have shown promise for automated software development, but applying them to hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) embedded and Internet-of-Things (IoT) systems remains challenging due to the tight coupling between software logic and physical hardware behavior. Code that compiles successfully may still fail when deployed on real devices because of timing constraints, peripheral initialization requirements, or hardware-specific behaviors. To address this challenge, we introduce a skills-based agentic framework for HIL embedded development together with IoT-SkillsBench, a benchmark designed to systematically evaluate AI agents in real embedded programming environments. IoT-SkillsBench spans three representative embedded platforms, 23 peripherals, and 42 tasks across three difficulty levels, where each task is evaluated under three agent configurations (no-skills, LLM-generated skills, and human-expert skills) and validated through real hardware execution. Across 378 hardware validated experiments, we show that concise human-expert skills with structured expert knowledge enable near-perfect success rates across platforms.

摘要（中文）：大型语言模型 (LLMs) 和代理系统在自动化软件开发方面展现出潜力，但将它们应用于硬件在环 (HIL) 嵌入式和物联网 (IoT) 系统仍然具有挑战性，因为软件逻辑和物理硬件行为之间存在紧密耦合。成功编译的代码在部署到实际设备上时仍可能因时序约束、外设初始化要求或硬件特定行为而失败。为了应对这一挑战，我们引入了一个基于技能的代理框架，用于 HIL 嵌入式开发，以及 IoT-SkillsBench，一个旨在系统地评估人工智能代理在实际嵌入式编程环境中的基准。IoT-SkillsBench 涵盖三个具有代表性的嵌入式平台、23 个外设和 42 个横跨三个难度级别的任务，其中每个任务都在三种代理配置（无技能、LLM 生成的技能和人类专家技能）下进行评估，并通过实际硬件执行进行验证。在 378 个经过硬件验证的实验中，我们表明，具有结构化专家知识的简洁人类专家技能能够在各种平台上实现接近完美的成功率。

Authors: Yiming Li, Yuhan Cheng, Mingchen Ma, Yihang Zou, Ningyuan Yang, Wei Cheng, Hai "Helen" Li, Yiran Chen, Tingjun Chen

ItinBench: Benchmarking Planning Across Multiple Cognitive Dimensions with Large Language Models

简要说明：该论文介绍了ItinBench，一个评估LLM在行程规划任务中表现的基准，该基准整合了语言和空间推理，揭示了LLM在多个认知维度上表现的不一致性。

TLDR: The paper introduces ItinBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on itinerary planning tasks that integrates both verbal and spatial reasoning, revealing performance inconsistency across multiple cognitive dimensions.

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) with advanced cognitive capabilities are emerging as agents for various reasoning and planning tasks. Traditional evaluations often focus on specific reasoning or planning questions within controlled environments. Recent studies have explored travel planning as a medium to integrate various verbal reasoning tasks into real-world contexts. However, reasoning tasks extend beyond verbal reasoning alone, and a comprehensive evaluation of LLMs requires a testbed that incorporates tasks from multiple cognitive domains. To address this gap, we introduce ItinBench, a benchmark that features one task of spatial reasoning, i.e., route optimization, into trip itinerary planning while keeping the traditional verbal reasoning tasks. ItinBench evaluates various LLMs across diverse tasks simultaneously, including Llama 3.1 8B, Mistral Large, Gemini 1.5 Pro, and GPT family. Our findings reveal that LLMs struggle to maintain high and consistent performance when concurrently handling multiple cognitive dimensions. By incorporating tasks from distinct human-level cognitive domains, ItinBench provides new insights into building more comprehensive reasoning testbeds that better reflect real-world challenges. The code and dataset: https://ethanwtl.github.io/IBweb/

摘要（中文）：摘要： 具有先进认知能力的大型语言模型(LLMs)正逐渐成为各种推理和规划任务的代理。传统的评估通常侧重于受控环境下的特定推理或规划问题。最近的研究探索了旅行计划作为将各种语言推理任务集成到现实环境中的媒介。然而，推理任务不仅限于语言推理，对LLM的全面评估需要一个包含来自多个认知领域任务的测试平台。为了弥补这一差距，我们推出了ItinBench，一个将空间推理任务（即路线优化）纳入旅行行程规划的基准，同时保留了传统的语言推理任务。ItinBench同时评估了各种LLM在不同任务上的表现，包括Llama 3.1 8B、Mistral Large、Gemini 1.5 Pro和GPT系列。我们的研究结果表明，LLM在同时处理多个认知维度时，难以保持高且一致的性能。通过整合来自不同人类认知领域的任务，ItinBench为构建更全面、更能反映现实世界挑战的推理测试平台提供了新的见解。代码和数据集：https://ethanwtl.github.io/IBweb/

Authors: Tianlong Wang, Pinqiao Wang, Weili Shi, Sheng li

Teaching an Agent to Sketch One Part at a Time

简要说明：该论文介绍了一种强化学习方法，通过新的数据集和奖励结构进行训练，用于从文本中逐部分生成矢量草图，从而实现可解释和可编辑的草图创建。

TLDR: This paper introduces a reinforcement learning approach, trained with a novel dataset and reward structure, for generating vector sketches part-by-part from text, enabling interpretable and editable sketch creation.

Abstract: We develop a method for producing vector sketches one part at a time. To do this, we train a multi-modal language model-based agent using a novel multi-turn process-reward reinforcement learning following supervised fine-tuning. Our approach is enabled by a new dataset we call ControlSketch-Part, containing rich part-level annotations for sketches, obtained using a novel, generic automatic annotation pipeline that segments vector sketches into semantic parts and assigns paths to parts with a structured multi-stage labeling process. Our results indicate that incorporating structured part-level data and providing agent with the visual feedback through the process enables interpretable, controllable, and locally editable text-to-vector sketch generation.

摘要（中文）：我们开发了一种逐步生成矢量草图的方法。为此，我们在监督式微调之后，使用一种新颖的多轮过程奖励强化学习，训练了一个基于多模态语言模型的智能体。我们的方法得益于一个新的数据集，我们称之为ControlSketch-Part，它包含丰富的草图部件级标注。该数据集是通过一种新颖的、通用的自动标注流水线获得的，该流水线将矢量草图分割成语义部件，并使用结构化的多阶段标注过程将路径分配给部件。我们的结果表明，结合结构化的部件级数据并通过过程提供给智能体视觉反馈，能够实现可解释、可控且局部可编辑的文本到矢量草图生成。

Authors: Xiaodan Du, Ruize Xu, David Yunis, Yael Vinker, Greg Shakhnarovich

Adaptive Layerwise Perturbation: Unifying Off-Policy Corrections for LLM RL

简要说明：该论文提出了自适应层级扰动 (ALP)，通过在隐藏状态中注入噪声来稳定 LLM RL 训练，减少重要性比率的尾部，并提高数学和推理任务的性能。

TLDR: The paper introduces Adaptive Layerwise Perturbation (ALP) to stabilize LLM RL training by injecting noise into hidden states, reducing the importance ratio tail and improving performance in math and reasoning tasks.

Abstract: Off-policy problems such as policy staleness and training-inference mismatch, has become a major bottleneck for training stability and further exploration for LLM RL. To enhance inference efficiency, the distribution gap between the inference and updated policy grows, leading to heavy-tailed importance ratios. Heavy-tailed ratios arise when the policy is locally sharp, which further inflates sharp gradients and can push updates outside the trust region. To address this, we propose Adaptive Layerwise Perturbation(ALP) by injecting small learnable perturbations into input hidden states of each layer during updates, which is used as the numerator of the importance ratio against the unchanged inference policy in the objective. Intuitively, by adding controlled noise to intermediate representations, ALP prevents the updated policy from deviating too sharply from the inference policy, and enlarges the policy family to cover the inference policy family with mismatch noises. Hence, the flattened distribution can naturally tighten the updated and inference policy gap and reduce the tail of importance ratios, thus maintaining training stability. This is further validated empirically. Experiments on single-turn math and multi-turn tool-integrated reasoning tasks show that ALP not only improves final performance, but also avoid blow up of importance ratio tail and KL spikes during iterative training, along with boosted exploration. Ablations show that representation-level perturbations across all layers are most effective, substantially outperforming partial-layer and logits-only variants.

摘要（中文）：策略陈旧和训练-推理不匹配等离线策略问题已成为LLM强化学习训练稳定性和进一步探索的主要瓶颈。为提高推理效率，推理策略和更新策略之间的分布差距增大，导致出现重尾重要性比率。当策略局部尖锐时，会产生重尾比率，这会进一步放大尖锐梯度，并将更新推离信任区域。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了自适应分层扰动（ALP），通过在更新过程中将小的可学习扰动注入到每一层的输入隐藏状态中，并将其用作目标函数中重要性比率的分子，与未改变的推理策略作对比。直观上，通过向中间表示添加可控噪声，ALP可以防止更新后的策略与推理策略发生过于剧烈的偏离，并扩大策略族以覆盖带有不匹配噪声的推理策略族。因此，展平的分布可以自然地缩小更新策略和推理策略的差距，并减小重要性比率的尾部，从而维持训练稳定性。这一点已通过实验进一步验证。在单轮数学和多轮集成工具推理任务上的实验表明，ALP不仅提高了最终性能，而且避免了迭代训练过程中重要性比率尾部的爆炸和KL散度峰值的出现，并促进了探索。消融实验表明，跨所有层的表示级别扰动最有效，明显优于部分层和仅logits变体。

Authors: Chenlu Ye, Xuanchang Zhang, Yifan Hao, Zhou Yu, Ziji Zhang, Abhinav Gullapalli, Hao Chen, Jing Huang, Tong Zhang

EgoForge: Goal-Directed Egocentric World Simulator

简要说明：EgoForge 是一种新颖的以自我为中心的场景模拟器，它通过最少的输入和指令引导的扩散生成第一人称视频，并在对齐、稳定性和保真度方面优于基线。该系统已在现实世界的智能眼镜实验中展示了成功。

TLDR: EgoForge is a novel egocentric world simulator that generates first-person videos from minimal inputs with instruction and reward-guided diffusion, outperforming baselines in alignment, stability, and fidelity. The system has demonstrated successful real-world smart-glasses experiments.

Abstract: Generative world models have shown promise for simulating dynamic environments, yet egocentric video remains challenging due to rapid viewpoint changes, frequent hand-object interactions, and goal-directed procedures whose evolution depends on latent human intent. Existing approaches either focus on hand-centric instructional synthesis with limited scene evolution, perform static view translation without modeling action dynamics, or rely on dense supervision, such as camera trajectories, long video prefixes, synchronized multicamera capture, etc. In this work, we introduce EgoForge, an egocentric goal-directed world simulator that generates coherent, first-person video rollouts from minimal static inputs: a single egocentric image, a high-level instruction, and an optional auxiliary exocentric view. To improve intent alignment and temporal consistency, we propose VideoDiffusionNFT, a trajectory-level reward-guided refinement that optimizes goal completion, temporal causality, scene consistency, and perceptual fidelity during diffusion sampling. Extensive experiments show EgoForge achieves consistent gains in semantic alignment, geometric stability, and motion fidelity over strong baselines, and robust performance in real-world smart-glasses experiments.

摘要（中文）：生成式世界模型在模拟动态环境方面展现出潜力，但第一人称视角视频仍然具有挑战性，原因在于快速的视点变化、频繁的手部-物体交互，以及其演变取决于潜在人类意图的目标导向程序。现有方法要么专注于手部中心的教学合成，但场景演化受限；要么执行静态视角转换，而不建模动作动力学；要么依赖于密集的监督，例如相机轨迹、长视频前缀、同步的多相机捕捉等等。在这项工作中，我们提出了EgoForge，一个第一人称视角的目标导向世界模拟器，可以从最少的静态输入生成连贯的第一人称视频展开序列：一张单一的第一人称视角图像、一条高级指令以及一个可选的辅助外视角视图。为了提高意图对齐和时间一致性，我们提出了VideoDiffusionNFT，一种轨迹级别的奖励引导细化方法，在扩散采样过程中优化目标完成度、时间因果关系、场景一致性和感知保真度。大量实验表明，相对于强大的基线模型，EgoForge在语义对齐、几何稳定性以及运动保真度方面均取得了持续的提升，并在真实世界的智能眼镜实验中表现出稳健的性能。

Authors: Yifan Shen, Jiateng Liu, Xinzhuo Li, Yuanzhe Liu, Bingxuan Li, Houze Yang, Wenqi Jia, Yijiang Li, Tianjiao Yu, James Matthew Rehg, Xu Cao, Ismini Lourentzou

Can Large Multimodal Models Inspect Buildings? A Hierarchical Benchmark for Structural Pathology Reasoning

简要说明：本文介绍了 DefectBench，一个用于评估大型多模态模型 (LMM) 在建筑物外立面检查中结构病理推理的新基准，揭示了 LMM 在语义理解方面的优势，但在度量定位方面的弱点，同时展示了有希望的零样本生成分割能力。

TLDR: This paper introduces DefectBench, a new benchmark for evaluating Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) on structural pathology reasoning for building facade inspection, revealing strengths in semantic understanding but weaknesses in metric localization while demonstrating promising zero-shot generative segmentation capabilities.

Abstract: Automated building facade inspection is a critical component of urban resilience and smart city maintenance. Traditionally, this field has relied on specialized discriminative models (e.g., YOLO, Mask R-CNN) that excel at pixel-level localization but are constrained to passive perception and worse generization without the visual understandng to interpret structural topology. Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) promise a paradigm shift toward active reasoning, yet their application in such high-stakes engineering domains lacks rigorous evaluation standards. To bridge this gap, we introduce a human-in-the-loop semi-automated annotation framework, leveraging expert-proposal verification to unify 12 fragmented datasets into a standardized, hierarchical ontology. Building on this foundation, we present \textit{DefectBench}, the first multi-dimensional benchmark designed to interrogate LMMs beyond basic semantic recognition. \textit{DefectBench} evaluates 18 state-of-the-art (SOTA) LMMs across three escalating cognitive dimensions: Semantic Perception, Spatial Localization, and Generative Geometry Segmentation. Extensive experiments reveal that while current LMMs demonstrate exceptional topological awareness and semantic understanding (effectively diagnosing "what" and "how"), they exhibit significant deficiencies in metric localization precision ("where"). Crucially, however, we validate the viability of zero-shot generative segmentation, showing that general-purpose foundation models can rival specialized supervised networks without domain-specific training. This work provides both a rigorous benchmarking standard and a high-quality open-source database, establishing a new baseline for the advancement of autonomous AI agents in civil engineering.

摘要（中文）：自动化建筑外立面检测是城市韧性和智慧城市维护的关键组成部分。传统上，该领域依赖于专门的判别模型（例如，YOLO，Mask R-CNN），这些模型擅长像素级定位，但受限于被动感知，且缺乏解释结构拓扑的视觉理解，导致泛化能力较差。大型多模态模型（LMMs）有望带来主动推理的范式转变，但其在此类高风险工程领域中的应用缺乏严格的评估标准。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了一个人机协作的半自动化标注框架，利用专家提议验证将12个零散的数据集合并为一个标准化的分层本体。在此基础上，我们提出了\textit{DefectBench}，这是首个旨在超越基本语义识别来探究LMMs的多维度基准。 \textit{DefectBench}在三个逐步提升的认知维度上评估了18个最先进的（SOTA）LMMs：语义感知、空间定位和生成式几何分割。大量实验表明，虽然当前的LMMs表现出卓越的拓扑意识和语义理解（有效地诊断“什么”和“如何”），但它们在度量定位精度（“在哪里”）方面存在显著缺陷。然而，至关重要的是，我们验证了零样本生成式分割的可行性，表明通用基础模型可以在没有特定领域训练的情况下与专门的监督网络相媲美。这项工作既提供了严格的基准标准，又提供了高质量的开源数据库，为土木工程中自主AI代理的进步建立了新的基线。
