Authors: Ji-il Park, Inwook Shim

Legged Autonomous Surface Science In Analogue Environments (LASSIE): Making Every Robotic Step Count in Planetary Exploration

简要说明：本文介绍了一种腿式机器人系统，该系统具有用于地形分析的新颖表面互动技术和用于自适应行星探测的受人类启发的数据采集算法，并在类比环境中进行了演示。

TLDR: This paper presents a legged robot system with novel surface interaction techniques for terrain analysis and human-inspired data acquisition algorithms for adaptive planetary exploration, demonstrated in analog environments.

Abstract: The ability to efficiently and effectively explore planetary surfaces is currently limited by the capability of wheeled rovers to traverse challenging terrains, and by pre-programmed data acquisition plans with limited in-situ flexibility. In this paper, we present two novel approaches to address these limitations: (i) high-mobility legged robots that use direct surface interactions to collect rich information about the terrain's mechanics to guide exploration; (ii) human-inspired data acquisition algorithms that enable robots to reason about scientific hypotheses and adapt exploration priorities based on incoming ground-sensing measurements. We successfully verify our approach through lab work and field deployments in two planetary analog environments. The new capability for legged robots to measure soil mechanical properties is shown to enable effective traversal of challenging terrains. When coupled with other geologic properties (e.g., composition, thermal properties, and grain size data etc), soil mechanical measurements reveal key factors governing the formation and development of geologic environments. We then demonstrate how human-inspired algorithms turn terrain-sensing robots into teammates, by supporting more flexible and adaptive data collection decisions with human scientists. Our approach therefore enables exploration of a wider range of planetary environments and new substrate investigation opportunities through integrated human-robot systems that support maximum scientific return.

摘要（中文）：目前，行星表面高效探索能力受限于轮式漫游车在复杂地形上的行驶能力，以及缺乏原位灵活性的预编程数据采集计划。本文提出了两种新颖的方法来解决这些局限性：(i) 高机动性腿式机器人，通过直接与表面交互来收集关于地形力学特性的丰富信息，从而指导探索；(ii) 受人类启发的数据采集算法，使机器人能够推理科学假设，并根据传入的地面传感测量结果调整探索优先级。我们通过实验室工作和在两个行星模拟环境中的现场部署成功验证了我们的方法。结果表明，腿式机器人测量土壤力学性质的新能力能够有效地穿越复杂地形。当与其他地质属性（例如，成分、热属性和粒度数据等）相结合时，土壤力学测量结果揭示了控制地质环境形成和发展的关键因素。然后，我们演示了受人类启发算法如何将地形感知机器人转变为团队成员，通过支持更灵活和自适应的数据收集决策来辅助人类科学家。因此，我们的方法能够通过集成了人机系统的行星探索，支持最大化的科学回报，从而探索更广泛的行星环境和提供新的基质调查机会。

Authors: Cristina G. Wilson, Marion Nachon, Shipeng Liu, John G. Ruck, J. Diego Caporale, Benjamin E. McKeeby, Yifeng Zhang, Jordan M. Bretzfelder, John Bush, Alivia M. Eng, Ethan Fulcher, Emmy B. Hughes, Ian C. Rankin, Jelis J. Sostre Cortés, Sophie Silver, Michael R. Zanetti, Ryan C. Ewing, Kenton R. Fisher, Douglas J. Jerolmack, Daniel E. Koditschek, Frances Rivera-Hernández, Thomas F. Shipley, Feifei Qian

Zero Shot Deformation Reconstruction for Soft Robots Using a Flexible Sensor Array and Cage Based 3D Gaussian Modeling

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于软机器人的零样本形变重建框架，该框架使用触觉传感和一个基于笼子的3D高斯形变模型，无需相机即可对未见过的机器人进行形变推断。该方法在弯曲和扭转运动中表现出强大的零样本泛化能力。

TLDR: This paper presents a zero-shot deformation reconstruction framework for soft robots using tactile sensing and a cage-based 3D Gaussian deformation model, enabling camera-free deformation inference on unseen robots. It demonstrates strong zero-shot generalization in bending and twisting motions.

Abstract: We present a zero-shot deformation reconstruction framework for soft robots that operates without any visual supervision at inference time. In this work, zero-shot deformation reconstruction is defined as the ability to infer object-wide deformations on previously unseen soft robots without collecting object-specific deformation data or performing any retraining during deployment. Our method assumes access to a static geometric proxy of the undeformed object, which can be obtained from a STL model. During operation, the system relies exclusively on tactile sensing, enabling camera-free deformation inference. The proposed framework integrates a flexible piezoresistive sensor array with a geometry-aware, cage-based 3D Gaussian deformation model. Local tactile measurements are mapped to low-dimensional cage control signals and propagated to dense Gaussian primitives to generate globally consistent shape deformations. A graph attention network regresses cage displacements from tactile input, enforcing spatial smoothness and structural continuity via boundary-aware propagation. Given only a nominal geometric proxy and real-time tactile signals, the system performs zero-shot deformation reconstruction of unseen soft robots in bending and twisting motions, while rendering photorealistic RGB in real time. It achieves 0.67 IoU, 0.65 SSIM, and 3.48 mm Chamfer distance, demonstrating strong zero-shot generalization through explicit coupling of tactile sensing and structured geometric deformation.

摘要（中文）：我们提出一个针对软机器人的零样本形变重建框架，该框架在推理时不依赖于任何视觉监督。在此工作中，零样本形变重建被定义为能够在未见过的软机器人上推断整体形变的能力，而无需收集特定对象的形变数据或在部署期间进行任何重新训练。我们的方法假设可以访问未变形对象的静态几何代理，例如从STL模型获得。在运行期间，系统完全依赖于触觉传感，从而实现无需摄像头的形变推断。所提出的框架将一个柔性压阻传感器阵列与一个几何感知的、基于笼子的三维高斯形变模型相结合。局部触觉测量被映射到低维笼子控制信号，并传播到密集高斯基元，从而生成全局一致的形状形变。一个图注意力网络从触觉输入回归笼子的位移，通过边界感知传播来强制执行空间平滑性和结构连续性。仅给出标称几何代理和实时触觉信号，系统就可以对未见过的软机器人进行弯曲和扭曲运动的零样本形变重建，同时实时渲染逼真的RGB图像。它实现了0.67 IoU、0.65 SSIM和3.48毫米的Chamfer距离，通过触觉传感和结构化几何形变的显式耦合，展示了强大的零样本泛化能力。

Authors: Linrui Shou, Zilang Chen, Wenjia Xu, Yiyue Luo, Tingyu Cheng

Unlabeled Multi-Robot Motion Planning with Improved Separation Trade-offs

简要说明：该论文提出了改进的多机器人运动规划算法，在密集环境中实现了更好的机器人和障碍物分离权衡，算法具有多项式时间复杂度，并提供了一个在无机器人分离限制下必要的障碍物分离条件。

TLDR: This paper presents improved polynomial-time constant-approximation algorithms for unlabeled multi-robot motion planning in densely packed environments, achieving better separation trade-offs between robots and obstacles than previous work. It also shows a necessary obstacle separation condition when robot separation is unrestricted.

Abstract: We study unlabeled multi-robot motion planning for unit-disk robots in a polygonal environment. Although the problem is hard in general, polynomial-time solutions exist under appropriate separation assumptions on start and target positions. Banyassady et al. (SoCG'22) guarantee feasibility in simple polygons under start--start and target--target distances of at least $4$, and start--target distances of at least $3$, but without optimality guarantees. Solovey et al. (RSS'15) provide a near-optimal solution in general polygonal domains, under stricter conditions: start/target positions must have pairwise distance at least $4$, and at least $\sqrt{5}\approx2.236$ from obstacles. This raises the question of whether polynomial-time algorithms can be obtained in even more densely packed environments. In this paper we present a generalized algorithm that achieve different trade-offs on the robots-separation and obstacles-separation bounds, all significantly improving upon the state of the art. Specifically, we obtain polynomial-time constant-approximation algorithms to minimize the total path length when (i) the robots-separation is $2\tfrac{2}{3}$ and the obstacles-separation is $1\tfrac{2}{3}$, or (ii) the robots-separation is $\approx3.291$ and the obstacles-separation $\approx1.354$. Additionally, we introduce a different strategy yielding a polynomial-time solution when the robots-separation is only $2$, and the obstacles-separation is $3$. Finally, we show that without any robots-separation assumption, obstacles-separation of at least $1.5$ may be necessary for a solution to exist.

摘要（中文）：我们研究了多边形环境下的单位圆盘机器人的无标签多机器人运动规划问题。尽管该问题通常是NP困难的，但在起始点和目标点之间满足适当分离假设的情况下，存在多项式时间解。Banyassady等人(SoCG'22)证明了在起始点-起始点距离和目标点-目标点距离至少为$4$，以及起始点-目标点距离至少为$3$的情况下，在简单多边形中的可行性，但未保证最优性。Solovey等人(RSS'15)在更严格的条件下，即起始点/目标点之间两两距离至少为$4$，且与障碍物距离至少为$\sqrt{5}\approx2.236$的情况下，提供了通用多边形域内的近似最优解。这引发了一个问题，即是否可以在更密集的环境中获得多项式时间算法。 在本文中，我们提出了一种通用算法，该算法在机器人分离和障碍物分离的界限上实现了不同的权衡，所有这些都显着改进了现有技术。具体来说，我们获得了多项式时间常数近似算法，以最小化总路径长度，当(i) 机器人分离为 $2\tfrac{2}{3}$ 且障碍物分离为 $1\tfrac{2}{3}$，或 (ii) 机器人分离为 $\approx3.291$ 且障碍物分离为 $\approx1.354$ 时。此外，我们引入了一种不同的策略，当机器人分离仅为 $2$，且障碍物分离为 $3$ 时，可获得多项式时间解。最后，我们表明在没有任何机器人分离假设的情况下，障碍物分离至少为 $1.5$ 可能是解存在的必要条件。

Authors: Tsuri Farhana, Omrit Filtser, Shalev Goldshtein

A Closed-Form CLF-CBF Controller for Whole-Body Continuum Soft Robot Collision Avoidance

简要说明：本文提出了一种闭式CLF-CBF控制器，用于软体连续操纵器的实时安全3D避障，与现有方法相比，速度有显著提高。

TLDR: This paper introduces a closed-form CLF-CBF controller for real-time, safe 3D obstacle avoidance for soft continuum manipulators, demonstrating significant speed improvements over existing methods.

Abstract: Safe operation is essential for deploying robots in human-centered 3D environments. Soft continuum manipulators provide passive safety through mechanical compliance, but still require active control to achieve reliable collision avoidance. Existing approaches, such as sampling-based planning, are often computationally expensive and lack formal safety guarantees, which limits their use for real-time whole-body avoidance. This paper presents a closed-form Control Lyapunov Function--Control Barrier Function (CLF--CBF) controller for real-time 3D obstacle avoidance in soft continuum manipulators without online optimization. By analytically embedding safety constraints into the control input, the proposed method ensures stability and safety under the stated modeling assumptions, while avoiding feasibility issues commonly encountered in online optimization-based methods. The resulting controller is up to $10\times$ faster than standard CLF--CBF quadratic-programming approaches and up to $100\times$ faster than traditional sampling-based planners. Simulation and hardware experiments on a tendon-driven soft manipulator demonstrate accurate 3D trajectory tracking and robust obstacle avoidance in cluttered environments. These results show that the proposed framework provides a scalable and provably safe control strategy for soft robots operating in dynamic, safety-critical settings.

摘要（中文）：在以人为中心的3D环境中部署机器人，安全运行至关重要。软连续体机械臂通过机械柔顺性提供被动安全，但仍需要主动控制来实现可靠的避障。现有的方法，例如基于采样的规划，通常计算量大且缺乏形式化的安全保证，这限制了它们在实时全身避障中的应用。 本文提出了一种用于软连续体机械臂实时3D避障的闭环控制李雅普诺夫函数--控制障碍函数 (CLF--CBF) 控制器，无需在线优化。通过将安全约束解析地嵌入到控制输入中，所提出的方法在所述建模假设下确保稳定性和安全性，同时避免了在线优化方法中常见的可行性问题。由此产生的控制器比标准的CLF--CBF二次规划方法快达10倍，比传统的基于采样的规划器快达100倍。 在腱驱动软机械臂上的仿真和硬件实验表明，该方法可以实现精确的3D轨迹跟踪和在杂乱环境中鲁棒的避障。这些结果表明，所提出的框架为在动态、安全关键环境中运行的软机器人提供了一种可扩展且可证明安全的控制策略。

Authors: Kiwan Wong, Maximillian Stölzle, Wei Xiao, Daniela Rus

Hyperagents

简要说明：该论文介绍了一种名为“超级代理”（Hyperagents）的自我改进AI架构，该架构不仅可以学习提高任务表现，还可以学习改进自身的学习机制，并在不同领域展示了改进后的性能。这是通过一个可编辑的元代理来实现的，该元代理可以修改自身和任务代理。

TLDR: The paper introduces "hyperagents," a self-improving AI architecture where the agent learns to improve not only task performance but also its own learning mechanisms, demonstrating improved performance across diverse domains. This is achieved through an editable meta-agent that can modify both itself and the task agent.

Abstract: Self-improving AI systems aim to reduce reliance on human engineering by learning to improve their own learning and problem-solving processes. Existing approaches to self-improvement rely on fixed, handcrafted meta-level mechanisms, fundamentally limiting how fast such systems can improve. The Darwin Gödel Machine (DGM) demonstrates open-ended self-improvement in coding by repeatedly generating and evaluating self-modified variants. Because both evaluation and self-modification are coding tasks, gains in coding ability can translate into gains in self-improvement ability. However, this alignment does not generally hold beyond coding domains. We introduce \textbf{hyperagents}, self-referential agents that integrate a task agent (which solves the target task) and a meta agent (which modifies itself and the task agent) into a single editable program. Crucially, the meta-level modification procedure is itself editable, enabling metacognitive self-modification, improving not only the task-solving behavior, but also the mechanism that generates future improvements. We instantiate this framework by extending DGM to create DGM-Hyperagents (DGM-H), eliminating the assumption of domain-specific alignment between task performance and self-modification skill to potentially support self-accelerating progress on any computable task. Across diverse domains, the DGM-H improves performance over time and outperforms baselines without self-improvement or open-ended exploration, as well as prior self-improving systems. Furthermore, the DGM-H improves the process by which it generates new agents (e.g., persistent memory, performance tracking), and these meta-level improvements transfer across domains and accumulate across runs. DGM-Hyperagents offer a glimpse of open-ended AI systems that do not merely search for better solutions, but continually improve their search for how to improve.

摘要（中文）：自提升人工智能系统旨在通过学习改进自身学习和问题解决过程，来减少对人为工程的依赖。现有的自提升方法依赖于固定的、手工设计的元层机制，这从根本上限制了此类系统改进的速度。达尔文哥德尔机 (DGM) 通过重复生成和评估自修改变体，展示了编码方面的开放式自提升。由于评估和自修改都是编码任务，因此编码能力的提升可以转化为自提升能力的提升。然而，这种一致性通常并不适用于编码领域之外。我们引入了\textbf{超代理}，一种自引用代理，将任务代理（解决目标任务）和元代理（修改自身和任务代理）集成到一个可编辑的程序中。至关重要的是，元层修改过程本身是可编辑的，从而实现元认知自修改，不仅改进了任务解决行为，还改进了生成未来改进的机制。我们通过扩展 DGM 以创建 DGM-超代理 (DGM-H) 来实例化这个框架，消除了任务性能和自修改技能之间特定于领域的一致性假设，从而有可能支持任何可计算任务上的自加速进展。在不同的领域中，DGM-H 随着时间推移改进性能，并优于没有自提升或开放式探索的baseline，以及先前的自提升系统。此外，DGM-H 改进了生成新代理的过程（例如，持久存储、性能跟踪），并且这些元层改进可以在不同领域之间转移并在运行中积累。DGM-超代理展现了开放式人工智能系统的雏形，它们不仅搜索更好的解决方案，而且不断改进它们寻找如何改进的搜索。

Authors: Jenny Zhang, Bingchen Zhao, Wannan Yang, Jakob Foerster, Jeff Clune, Minqi Jiang, Sam Devlin, Tatiana Shavrina

MuSteerNet: Human Reaction Generation from Videos via Observation-Reaction Mutual Steering

简要说明：MuSteerNet致力于解决生成对视频的真实人类反应的问题，通过使用互导框架减轻视觉观察和反应类型之间的关系失真。它利用原型反馈引导和双重耦合反应细化。

TLDR: MuSteerNet addresses the problem of generating realistic human reactions to videos by mitigating relational distortion between visual observations and reaction types using a mutual steering framework. It leverages prototype feedback steering and dual-coupled reaction refinement.

Abstract: Video-driven human reaction generation aims to synthesize 3D human motions that directly react to observed video sequences, which is crucial for building human-like interactive AI systems. However, existing methods often fail to effectively leverage video inputs to steer human reaction synthesis, resulting in reaction motions that are mismatched with the content of video sequences. We reveal that this limitation arises from a severe relational distortion between visual observations and reaction types. In light of this, we propose MuSteerNet, a simple yet effective framework that generates 3D human reactions from videos via observation-reaction mutual steering. Specifically, we first propose a Prototype Feedback Steering mechanism to mitigate relational distortion by refining visual observations with a gated delta-rectification modulator and a relational margin constraint, guided by prototypical vectors learned from human reactions. We then introduce Dual-Coupled Reaction Refinement that fully leverages rectified visual cues to further steer the refinement of generated reaction motions, thereby effectively improving reaction quality and enabling MuSteerNet to achieve competitive performance. Extensive experiments and ablation studies validate the effectiveness of our method. Code coming soon: https://github.com/zhouyuan888888/MuSteerNet.

摘要（中文）：基于视频的人类反应生成旨在合成能够直接对观察到的视频序列做出反应的3D人体动作，这对于构建类人交互式AI系统至关重要。然而，现有方法通常无法有效地利用视频输入来引导人类反应合成，导致反应动作与视频序列内容不匹配。我们揭示了这种局限性源于视觉观察和反应类型之间严重的关联扭曲。有鉴于此，我们提出MuSteerNet，这是一个简单而有效的框架，通过观察-反应互导来从视频生成3D人类反应。具体而言，我们首先提出一种原型反馈引导机制，通过使用门控Delta-校正调制器和一个关系边界约束来细化视觉观察，从而缓解关联扭曲，而该过程由从人类反应中学习到的原型向量引导。然后，我们引入双耦合反应细化，充分利用校正后的视觉线索来进一步引导生成反应动作的细化，从而有效提高反应质量，并使MuSteerNet能够实现具有竞争力的性能。大量的实验和消融研究验证了我们方法的有效性。代码即将发布：https://github.com/zhouyuan888888/MuSteerNet。

Authors: Yuan Zhou, Yongzhi Li, Yanqi Dai, Xingyu Zhu, Yi Tan, Qingshan Xu, Beier Zhu, Richang Hong, Hanwang Zhang

Generalizable NGP-SR: Generalizable Neural Radiance Fields Super-Resolution via Neural Graph Primitives

简要说明：该论文介绍了 Generalizable NGP-SR，一个 3D 感知的超分辨率框架，利用神经图形基元从低分辨率图像重建高分辨率辐射场，从而实现视角一致的新视角合成，而无需针对每个场景进行优化。

TLDR: The paper introduces Generalizable NGP-SR, a 3D-aware super-resolution framework leveraging Neural Graphics Primitives to reconstruct high-resolution radiance fields from low-resolution images, enabling view-consistent novel view synthesis without per-scene optimization.

Abstract: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) achieve photorealistic novel view synthesis but become costly when high-resolution (HR) rendering is required, as HR outputs demand dense sampling and higher-capacity models. Moreover, naively super-resolving per-view renderings in 2D often breaks multi-view consistency. We propose Generalizable NGP-SR, a 3D-aware super-resolution framework that reconstructs an HR radiance field directly from low-resolution (LR) posed images. Built on Neural Graphics Primitives (NGP), NGP-SR conditions radiance prediction on 3D coordinates and learned local texture tokens, enabling recovery of high-frequency details within the radiance field and producing view-consistent HR novel views without external HR references or post-hoc 2D upsampling. Importantly, our model is generalizable: once trained, it can be applied to unseen scenes and rendered from novel viewpoints without per-scene optimization. Experiments on multiple datasets show that NGP-SR consistently improves both reconstruction quality and runtime efficiency over prior NeRF-based super-resolution methods, offering a practical solution for scalable high-resolution novel view synthesis.

摘要（中文）：神经辐射场(NeRF)能够实现逼真的新视角合成，但当需要高分辨率(HR)渲染时，其计算成本会变得非常高昂，因为HR输出需要密集的采样和更高容量的模型。此外，在2D中简单地对每个视角的渲染进行超分辨率处理通常会破坏多视角一致性。我们提出了可泛化的NGP-SR，一个3D感知的超分辨率框架，可以直接从低分辨率(LR)姿态图像重建HR辐射场。基于神经图形基元(NGP)，NGP-SR将辐射预测建立在3D坐标和学习到的局部纹理令牌上，从而能够在辐射场内恢复高频细节，并产生视角一致的HR新视角，而无需外部HR参考或后处理2D上采样。重要的是，我们的模型是可泛化的：一旦训练完成，它可以应用于未见过的场景，并从新的视点进行渲染，而无需针对每个场景进行优化。在多个数据集上的实验表明，与先前的基于NeRF的超分辨率方法相比，NGP-SR在重建质量和运行效率上都能持续改进，为可扩展的高分辨率新视角合成提供了一种实用的解决方案。

Authors: Wanqi Yuan, Omkar Sharad Mayekar, Connor Pennington, Nianyi Li

Cov2Pose: Leveraging Spatial Covariance for Direct Manifold-aware 6-DoF Object Pose Estimation

简要说明：本文提出了一种新的直接6自由度物体姿态估计方法，该方法利用协方差池化和流形感知网络头来实现连续姿态表示，与之前的直接方法相比，提高了准确性和鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper introduces a novel direct 6-DoF object pose estimation method using covariance pooling and a manifold-aware network head for continuous pose representation, demonstrating improved accuracy and robustness compared to previous direct methods.

Abstract: In this paper, we address the problem of 6-DoF object pose estimation from a single RGB image. Indirect methods that typically predict intermediate 2D keypoints, followed by a Perspective-n-Point solver, have shown great performance. Direct approaches, which regress the pose in an end-to-end manner, are usually computationally more efficient but less accurate. However, direct heads rely on globally pooled features, ignoring spatial second-order statistics despite their informativeness in pose prediction. They also predict, in most cases, discontinuous pose representations that lack robustness. Herein, we therefore propose a covariance-pooled representation that encodes convolutional feature distributions as a symmetric positive definite (SPD) matrix. Moreover, we propose a novel pose encoding in the form of an SPD matrix via its Cholesky decomposition. Pose is then regressed in an end-to-end manner with a manifold-aware network head, taking into account the Riemannian geometry of SPD matrices. Experiments and ablations consistently demonstrate the relevance of second-order pooling and continuous representations for direct pose regression, including under partial occlusion.

摘要（中文）：本文探讨了从单张RGB图像中进行6自由度物体姿态估计的问题。通常预测中间二维关键点，然后使用透视-n-点解算器的间接方法已经展现出优异的性能。直接方法以端到端的方式回归姿态，通常计算效率更高，但精度较低。然而，直接方法依赖于全局池化的特征，忽略了空间二阶统计信息，尽管它们在姿态预测中具有信息量。此外，在大多数情况下，它们预测的姿态表示是不连续的，缺乏鲁棒性。因此，我们在此提出一种协方差池化的表示方法，该方法将卷积特征分布编码为对称正定（SPD）矩阵。此外，我们提出了一种新颖的姿态编码方法，以SPD矩阵的形式通过其Cholesky分解来实现。然后采用流形感知网络头部以端到端的方式回归姿态，同时考虑到SPD矩阵的黎曼几何。实验和消融研究一致表明了在直接姿态回归中二阶池化和连续表示的相关性，包括在部分遮挡情况下。

Authors: Nassim Ali Ousalah, Peyman Rostami, Vincent Gaudillière, Emmanuel Koumandakis, Anis Kacem, Enjie Ghorbel, Djamila Aouada

FlashCap: Millisecond-Accurate Human Motion Capture via Flashing LEDs and Event-Based Vision

简要说明：该论文介绍了一种使用闪烁LED和事件视觉的毫秒级精确人体运动捕捉系统 FlashCap，以及一个新的高分辨率数据集 (FlashMotion) 和一个基线模型 (ResPose)，该模型将姿态估计提高了约 40%，并实现了毫秒级的定时精度。

TLDR: The paper introduces FlashCap, a millisecond-accurate human motion capture system using flashing LEDs and event-based vision, along with a new high-resolution dataset (FlashMotion) and a baseline model (ResPose) that improves pose estimation by ~40% and achieves millisecond-level timing accuracy.

Abstract: Precise motion timing (PMT) is crucial for swift motion analysis. A millisecond difference may determine victory or defeat in sports competitions. Despite substantial progress in human pose estimation (HPE), PMT remains largely overlooked by the HPE community due to the limited availability of high-temporal-resolution labeled datasets. Today, PMT is achieved using high-speed RGB cameras in specialized scenarios such as the Olympic Games; however, their high costs, light sensitivity, bandwidth, and computational complexity limit their feasibility for daily use. We developed FlashCap, the first flashing LED-based MoCap system for PMT. With FlashCap, we collect a millisecond-resolution human motion dataset, FlashMotion, comprising the event, RGB, LiDAR, and IMU modalities, and demonstrate its high quality through rigorous validation. To evaluate the merits of FlashMotion, we perform two tasks: precise motion timing and high-temporal-resolution HPE. For these tasks, we propose ResPose, a simple yet effective baseline that learns residual poses based on events and RGBs. Experimental results show that ResPose reduces pose estimation errors by ~40% and achieves millisecond-level timing accuracy, enabling new research opportunities. The dataset and code will be shared with the community.

摘要（中文）：精确运动时间（PMT）对于快速运动分析至关重要。毫秒级的差异可能决定体育比赛中的胜负。尽管人体姿态估计（HPE）取得了显著进展，但由于缺乏高时间分辨率的标注数据集，PMT在很大程度上被HPE领域所忽视。目前，PMT通常在奥运会等特定场景中使用高速RGB相机实现；然而，其高昂的成本、对光照的敏感性、带宽限制和计算复杂度限制了其在日常使用中的可行性。我们开发了FlashCap，这是第一个基于闪烁LED的运动捕捉系统（MoCap），用于PMT。利用FlashCap，我们收集了一个毫秒级分辨率的人体运动数据集FlashMotion，其包含事件、RGB、LiDAR和IMU多种模态，并通过严格的验证证明了其高质量。为了评估FlashMotion的优点，我们执行了两项任务：精确运动时间和高时间分辨率的HPE。针对这些任务，我们提出了ResPose，一个简单而有效的基线模型，它学习基于事件和RGB的残差姿态。实验结果表明，ResPose将姿态估计误差降低了约40%，并实现了毫秒级的计时精度，从而为新的研究机会提供了可能。数据集和代码将与社区共享。

Authors: Zekai Wu, Shuqi Fan, Mengyin Liu, Yuhua Luo, Xincheng Lin, Ming Yan, Junhao Wu, Xiuhong Lin, Yuexin Ma, Chenglu Wen, Lan Xu, Siqi Shen, Cheng Wang

PCSTracker: Long-Term Scene Flow Estimation for Point Cloud Sequences

简要说明：该论文介绍了PCSTracker，一种用于点云序列中长期场景流估计的端到端框架。它通过整合时间一致性、遮挡处理和误差抑制，解决了现有成对方法的局限性。

TLDR: The paper introduces PCSTracker, a novel end-to-end framework for long-term scene flow estimation in point cloud sequences, addressing limitations of existing pairwise methods by incorporating temporal consistency, occlusion handling, and error suppression.

Abstract: Point cloud scene flow estimation is fundamental to long-term and fine-grained 3D motion analysis. However, existing methods are typically limited to pairwise settings and struggle to maintain temporal consistency over long sequences as geometry evolves, occlusions emerge, and errors accumulate. In this work, we propose PCSTracker, the first end-to-end framework specifically designed for consistent scene flow estimation in point cloud sequences. Specifically, we introduce an iterative geometry motion joint optimization module (IGMO) that explicitly models the temporal evolution of point features to alleviate correspondence inconsistencies caused by dynamic geometric changes. In addition, a spatio-temporal point trajectory update module (STTU) is proposed to leverage broad temporal context to infer plausible positions for occluded points, ensuring coherent motion estimation. To further handle long sequences, we employ an overlapping sliding-window inference strategy that alternates cross-window propagation and in-window refinement, effectively suppressing error accumulation and maintaining stable long-term motion consistency. Extensive experiments on the synthetic PointOdyssey3D and real-world ADT3D datasets show that PCSTracker achieves the best accuracy in long-term scene flow estimation and maintains real-time performance at 32.5 FPS, while demonstrating superior 3D motion understanding compared to RGB-D-based approaches.

摘要（中文）：点云场景流估计是长期和细粒度3D 运动分析的基础。 然而，现有方法通常仅限于成对设置，并且难以在几何演变、遮挡出现和误差累积的情况下，在长序列中保持时间一致性。 在这项工作中，我们提出了PCSTracker，这是第一个专门为点云序列中一致的场景流估计而设计的端到端框架。 具体来说，我们引入了一个迭代几何运动联合优化模块（IGMO），该模块显式地建模了点特征的时间演变，以减轻由动态几何变化引起的对应关系不一致。 此外，还提出了一种时空点轨迹更新模块（STTU），利用广泛的时间上下文来推断被遮挡点的合理位置，从而确保连贯的运动估计。 为了进一步处理长序列，我们采用重叠滑动窗口推理策略，交替进行跨窗口传播和窗口内细化，有效地抑制误差累积并保持稳定的长期运动一致性。 在合成的PointOdyssey3D和真实的ADT3D数据集上的大量实验表明，PCSTracker在长期场景流估计中实现了最佳精度，并保持了32.5 FPS 的实时性能，同时与基于RGB-D的方法相比，表现出卓越的3D 运动理解能力。

Authors: Min Lin, Gangwei Xu, Xianqi Wang, Yuyi Peng, Xin Yang

Heavy-Tailed and Long-Range Dependent Noise in Stochastic Approximation: A Finite-Time Analysis

简要说明：该论文分析了重尾和长程依赖噪声下的随机逼近（SA），提供了有限时间收敛保证，并将其应用于SGD和梯度博弈。该分析使用了一种新颖的噪声平均技术。

TLDR: This paper analyzes stochastic approximation (SA) under heavy-tailed and long-range dependent noise, providing finite-time convergence guarantees and applying it to SGD and gradient play. The analysis uses a novel noise-averaging technique.

Abstract: Stochastic approximation (SA) is a fundamental iterative framework with broad applications in reinforcement learning and optimization. Classical analyses typically rely on martingale difference or Markov noise with bounded second moments, but many practical settings, including finance and communications, frequently encounter heavy-tailed and long-range dependent (LRD) noise. In this work, we study SA for finding the root of a strongly monotone operator under these non-classical noise models. We establish the first finite-time moment bounds in both settings, providing explicit convergence rates that quantify the impact of heavy tails and temporal dependence. Our analysis employs a noise-averaging argument that regularizes the impact of noise without modifying the iteration. Finally, we apply our general framework to stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and gradient play, and corroborate our finite-time analysis through numerical experiments.

摘要（中文）：随机逼近 (SA) 是一种基本的迭代框架，在强化学习和优化领域有着广泛的应用。传统的分析通常依赖于鞅差或具有有界二阶矩的马尔可夫噪声，但许多实际场景，包括金融和通信，经常遇到重尾和长程相关 (LRD) 噪声。 在这项工作中，我们研究了在这些非经典噪声模型下，使用 SA 寻找强单调算子的根。我们建立了这两种情况下首个有限时间矩界限，提供了量化重尾和时间依赖性影响的显式收敛速度。我们的分析采用了一种噪声平均论证，可以在不修改迭代的情况下规范化噪声的影响。最后，我们将我们的通用框架应用于随机梯度下降 (SGD) 和梯度博弈，并通过数值实验证实了我们的有限时间分析。

Authors: Siddharth Chandak, Anuj Yadav, Ayfer Ozgur, Nicholas Bambos

Deep Hilbert--Galerkin Methods for Infinite-Dimensional PDEs and Optimal Control

简要说明：本文介绍了基于深度学习的 Hilbert-Galerkin 方法，使用 HGNOs 来解决高维、完全非线性偏微分方程和最优控制问题。论文证明了通用逼近定理，并在与热方程和 Burgers 方程相关的控制问题上展示了有希望的结果。

TLDR: This paper introduces Deep Hilbert-Galerkin Methods using HGNOs for solving high-dimensional, fully nonlinear PDEs and optimal control problems, proving universal approximation theorems and demonstrating promising results on control problems related to heat and Burgers' equations.

Abstract: We develop deep learning-based approximation methods for fully nonlinear second-order PDEs on separable Hilbert spaces, such as HJB equations for infinite-dimensional control, by parameterizing solutions via Hilbert--Galerkin Neural Operators (HGNOs). We prove the first Universal Approximation Theorems (UATs) which are sufficiently powerful to address these problems, based on novel topologies for Hessian terms and corresponding novel continuity assumptions on the fully nonlinear operator. These topologies are non-sequential and non-metrizable, making the problem delicate. In particular, we prove UATs for functions on Hilbert spaces, together with their Fréchet derivatives up to second order, and for unbounded operators applied to the first derivative, ensuring that HGNOs are able to approximate all the PDE terms. For control problems, we further prove UATs for optimal feedback controls in terms of our approximating value function HGNO. We develop numerical training methods, which we call Deep Hilbert--Galerkin and Hilbert Actor-Critic (reinforcement learning) Methods, for these problems by minimizing the $L^2_μ(H)$-norm of the residual of the PDE on the whole Hilbert space, not just a projected PDE to finite dimensions. This is the first paper to propose such an approach. The models considered arise in many applied sciences, such as functional differential equations in physics and Kolmogorov and HJB PDEs related to controlled PDEs, SPDEs, path-dependent systems, partially observed stochastic systems, and mean-field SDEs. We numerically solve examples of Kolmogorov and HJB PDEs related to the optimal control of deterministic and stochastic heat and Burgers' equations, demonstrating the promise of our deep learning-based approach.

摘要（中文）：我们开发了基于深度学习的近似方法，用于求解可分离希尔伯特空间上的全非线性二阶偏微分方程，例如无限维控制的HJB方程，方法是通过希尔伯特-伽辽金神经算子（HGNOs）参数化解。我们基于 Hessian 项的新颖拓扑结构以及全非线性算子相应的新的连续性假设，证明了首个足以解决这些问题的通用逼近定理（UATs）。这些拓扑结构是非序列的和非可度量的，这使得问题变得微妙。特别是，我们证明了希尔伯特空间上的函数及其一阶和二阶Fréchet导数的UAT，以及应用于一阶导数的无界算子的UAT，确保了HGNOs能够逼近所有的PDE项。对于控制问题，我们进一步证明了最优反馈控制关于我们逼近值函数HGNO的UAT。 我们开发了数值训练方法，称之为深度希尔伯特-伽辽金和希尔伯特Actor-Critic（强化学习）方法，通过最小化整个希尔伯特空间上PDE残差的 $L^2_μ(H)$-范数来求解这些问题，而不仅仅是投影到有限维度的 PDE 。这是第一篇提出这种方法的论文。所考虑的模型出现在许多应用科学中，例如物理学中的泛函微分方程以及与受控PDE、SPDE、路径依赖系统、部分观测的随机系统和平均场SDE相关的 Kolmogorov 和 HJB PDE。我们数值求解了与确定性和随机热方程以及 Burgers' 方程的最优控制相关的 Kolmogorov 和 HJB PDE 示例，展示了我们基于深度学习方法的前景。

Authors: Samuel N. Cohen, Filippo de Feo, Jackson Hebner, Justin Sirignano

Optimizing Resource-Constrained Non-Pharmaceutical Interventions for Multi-Cluster Outbreak Control Using Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning

简要说明：本文提出了一种分层强化学习框架，用于优化资源分配以控制多集群疾病爆发。在 SARS-CoV-2 模拟中，该方法比基线方法表现出更好的性能和可扩展性。

TLDR: This paper introduces a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework to optimize resource allocation for controlling multi-cluster disease outbreaks, demonstrating improved performance and scalability compared to baselines in a SARS-CoV-2 simulation.

Abstract: Non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs), such as diagnostic testing and quarantine, are crucial for controlling infectious disease outbreaks but are often constrained by limited resources, particularly in early outbreak stages. In real-world public health settings, resources must be allocated across multiple outbreak clusters that emerge asynchronously, vary in size and risk, and compete for a shared resource budget. Here, a cluster corresponds to a group of close contacts generated by a single infected index case. Thus, decisions must be made under uncertainty and heterogeneous demands, while respecting operational constraints. We formulate this problem as a constrained restless multi-armed bandit and propose a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework. A global controller learns a continuous action cost multiplier that adjusts global resource demand, while a generalized local policy estimates the marginal value of allocating resources to individuals within each cluster. We evaluate the proposed framework in a realistic agent-based simulator of SARS-CoV-2 with dynamically arriving clusters. Across a wide range of system scales and testing budgets, our method consistently outperforms RMAB-inspired and heuristic baselines, improving outbreak control effectiveness by 20%-30%. Experiments on up to 40 concurrently active clusters further demonstrate that the hierarchical framework is highly scalable and enables faster decision-making than the RMAB-inspired method.

摘要（中文）：非药物干预措施（NPIs），如诊断检测和隔离，对于控制传染病爆发至关重要，但通常受到资源限制，尤其是在疫情爆发的早期阶段。在真实的公共卫生环境中，资源必须在多个异步出现、规模和风险各异且竞争共享资源预算的疫情集群之间进行分配。在此，一个集群对应于由单个感染的指标病例产生的一组密切接触者。因此，必须在不确定性和异构需求下做出决策，同时遵守操作约束。我们将此问题建模为一个受约束的restless multi-armed bandit问题，并提出一个分层强化学习框架。一个全局控制器学习一个连续的行动成本倍数，用于调整全局资源需求，而一个广义的局部策略估计将资源分配给每个集群内个体的边际价值。我们在一个真实的、具有动态到达集群的SARS-CoV-2的基于代理的仿真器中评估了所提出的框架。在广泛的系统规模和检测预算下，我们的方法始终优于受RMAB启发的基线方法和启发式方法，将疫情控制效果提高了20%-30%。对多达40个并发活动集群的实验进一步表明，该分层框架具有高度可扩展性，并且能够比受RMAB启发的基线方法更快地做出决策。
